title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend)
description:
LionsBot builds autonomous cleaning robots. More than 5,000 of them are working right now in malls, airports, offices and factories across 30+ countries, and every one of them is driven by software. That software is what you would build. Small team, quick decisions, no bureaucracy, and hardware you can actually touch.

Most front-end work is invisible. Ours is not. People stand in front of your screens and press buttons that make a robot move. Get it right and someone who has never touched a robot before finishes their first shift without asking anyone for help.

You would join a team that ships fast and cares about how things are built. Plenty is already live, plenty is still to build, and there is real room to shape how we build it.

The problems, all real

  • A robot drives into a basement, Wi-Fi drops mid-mission, and someone is still watching the screen. Decide what the UI shows, and make sure it is never confidently wrong.

  • Thousands of robots streaming live state into one view, across 30+ countries and time zones. Make it load fast and stay smooth.

  • A touchscreen operated with gloves on, in a language you do not read. Make it obvious anyway.

  • Screens that live on very different devices. Make them feel like one product without building everything twice.

What you will do

  • Build the interfaces people use to run our robots. Web, mobile, on the robot itself, and whatever comes next.

  • Turn designs into screens that match what the designer drew, down to the pixel.

  • Make live data feel live. Robot state over WebSocket, dropped connections, stale data, offline. What is on screen matches what the robot is doing.

  • Keep it fast. Load times, transitions, latency from robot event to pixel. Measure it, then fix it.

  • Build shared components so we stop solving the same problem twice.

  • Ship often. Automated builds, small releases, nothing sitting in a branch for a month.

  • Prototype with design and product, argue about the details, then ship.

  • Raise the bar in code review, and leave the codebase clearer than you found it.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years building front ends, with apps you took all the way to production yourself. Deployed, released, supported after.

  • Deep React and TypeScript.

  • Flutter or Dart is a big plus, as is any mobile framework. If you are strong in React and want to go deeper on mobile, we will back you.

  • Solid HTML, JavaScript/TypeScript and CSS. Comfortable with APIs and real-time protocols like WebSockets and WebRTC.

  • You have built UI on top of live data from real devices, not just forms and tables.

  • You learn fast and adapt. New codebase, new framework, shifting priorities, none of it throws you.

  • You ship quality work quickly. Fast and sloppy is easy, slow and perfect is easy, we need both at once.

  • An eye for detail. It bothers you when something is two pixels off.

Nice to have:

  • Robotics, IoT or connected-hardware experience: fleet dashboards, telemetry, device control.

  • Depth in the mobile release process: staged rollouts, store review, hotfixes and rollbacks under pressure.

  • Embedded or kiosk-style UI: touchscreens, limited hardware, gloved hands, harsh lighting.

  • Internationalisation and multi-language UI across several markets.

  • Map and geospatial UI: our robots navigate real floors, so maps and live location are first-class citizens.

  • Design-system or component-library ownership at a previous company.

  • Front-end testing and CI discipline: component tests, visual regression, performance budgets.

  • Familiarity with ROS, OpenRMF, MQTT or other robotics communication stacks.

Why join:

  • Real ownership. The architecture and the standards are yours to shape.

  • our work is visible. Thousands of robots in 30+ countries are run through the screens you build. What you ship this month is on a shop floor next month.

  • Physical-world software. Live robot state, real hardware, real constraints. Not another admin panel.

  • Small team, direct line to leadership, quick decisions, no bureaucracy.

  • AI-forward team. We already use AI-assisted workflows in production, and we will give you the tools to push it further.

If you're a Software Engineer who's passionate about building technologies that power robots and enhance people's lives, we want you to join our team. Our work environment is dynamic and collaborative, and you'll work with a team of experts who are as passionate about building robots as you are.

title: Economist
description:
Job summary

Ofgem is Great Britain's independent energy regulator. We are at the forefront of change across the energy sector, playing a vital role in ensuring that households and businesses across Great Britain have access to reliable, affordable and sustainable energy. As the energy system becomes more complex and the transition to Net Zero accelerates, robust analysis and evidence-based decision-making are more important than ever.

The Infrastructure Economics team sits within Ofgem's Office of Research and Economics (ORE), providing economics and analytical support to a wide range of projects across the Infrastructure Group. Our work contributes to major regulatory decisions affecting energy consumers, infrastructure investment and the development of Great Britain's future energy system.

This role provides an excellent opportunity for economists looking to develop their experience across a broad range of energy and regulatory issues. Working alongside experienced economists and multidisciplinary colleagues, you will contribute to analytical projects that inform policy development and regulatory decision-making in areas such as network regulation, major infrastructure projects and energy system reform.

You will support the delivery of economic analysis and impact assessments, help develop evidence bases for policy decisions, and communicate analytical findings to a range of audiences. The role offers exposure to complex and high-profile work while providing opportunities to build expertise in economic analysis, regulation and the energy sector.

You will:

  • Support the delivery of high-quality analytical work across a range of infrastructure and energy system projects.
  • Apply economic thinking and analytical techniques to assess issues and develop practical recommendations.
  • Develop effective working relationships with colleagues across Ofgem and, where appropriate, with external stakeholders.

Job description

Key Responsibilities

Reporting to a Senior Economist, your responsibilities will include:

  • Undertaking economic and analytical work to support policy development, regulatory decision-making and problem solving across a range of infrastructure-related projects.
  • Gathering, interpreting and analysing evidence and data to support the development of robust recommendations and policy options.
  • Supporting the delivery of impact assessments, policy evaluations and other analytical outputs, ensuring work is accurate, proportionate and delivered to agreed timescales.
  • Applying economic thinking and established analytical approaches to assess the potential impacts of regulatory and policy proposals.
  • Contributing to analytical work supporting major infrastructure projects, energy system reforms and network price control activities.
  • Producing clear written outputs, including briefings, presentations, consultation material and analytical summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Working collaboratively with economists, policy teams and other specialists across Ofgem to support project delivery.
  • Building productive working relationships with internal stakeholders and contributing to engagement with external organisations, including DESNZ, NESO and other regulatory partners.

Person specification

Essential

  • Degree in Economics or a related subject, or equivalent capability gained through relevant professional experience applying economic analysis. (Lead Criteria)
  • Experience of delivering analytical or economic work, including gathering, interpreting and presenting evidence to support decision-making across one or more projects. (Lead Criteria)
  • Ability to apply structured analytical thinking to complex issues and develop evidence-based conclusions and recommendations.
  • Ability to synthesise and communicate analysis, ideas and data clearly for different audiences, both verbally and in writing.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues from different professional backgrounds.
  • Ability to manage and prioritise work effectively to deliver quality outputs within agreed timescales.

Behaviours

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:

  • Working Together
  • Communicating and Influencing
  • Delivering at Pace

Benefits

Alongside your salary of 35,232, OFGEM contributes 10,206 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

Ofgem can offer you a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes; 30 days annual leave after 2 years; Excellent training and development opportunities; The opportunity to join the generous Civil Service pension which also includes a valuable range of benefits; hybrid working (currently 1 day a week in the office but this is kept under review), flexible working hours and family friendly policies. Plus lots of other benefits including clean and bright offices based centrally, engaged networks and teams and an opportunity to contribute to our ambitious and important targets of establishing a Net Zero energy system by 2050. This exciting blend of professional challenge and personal reward identifies career opportunities at Ofgem as something to get excited about.

Things you need to know

Artificial intelligence
Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Selection process details

This vacancy is using Success Profiles (opens in a new window) , and will assess your Behaviours and Experience.

When you press the Apply now button, you will be asked to complete personal details (not seen by the sift panel), your career history and qualifications.

You will then be asked to provide a 1250 word personal statement evidencing how you meet the essential criteriaand capabilities listed in the role profile. Please ensure you demonstrate clearly, within your supporting statement, how you meet each of the criteria listed in the role profile. In the event of receiving a large number of applications, an initial sift may take place on just the lead criteria indicated in the essential criteria.

The personal information we have collected from you will be shared with Cifas who will use it to prevent fraud, other unlawful or dishonest conduct, malpractice, and other seriously improper conduct. If any of these are detected, you could be refused certain services or employment. Your personal information will also be used to verify your identity. Further details of how your information will be used by us and Cifas, and your data protection rights, can be found by [ https://www.cifas.org.uk/fpn ].

At Ofgem, we expect our staff to carry out their roles with honesty, fairness and openness. They should follow the Civil Service code and be free from any influence or bias. We are committed to making sure interests are recognised, declared and managed appropriately so that we can fulfil our duties as an energy regulator. Our Conflicts of Interest policy outlines the types of interests Ofgem staff must declare before onboarding, and the rules they must follow throughout employment so that we can clearly demonstrate that our decisions are not influenced by private interests.

Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.

Security

Successful candidates must undergo a basic (or equivalent) criminal record check.

People working with government assets must complete baseline personnel security standard (opens in new window) checks.

Nationality requirements

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window)
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window)

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code (opens in a new window) sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles (opens in a new window) .

The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria.

The Civil Service also offers a Redeployment Interview Scheme to civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the advertised vacancy.

Diversity and Inclusion
The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan (opens in a new window) and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy (opens in a new window) .

Apply and further information

This vacancy is part of the Great Place to Work for Veterans (opens in a new window) initiative.

The Civil Service welcomes applications from people who have recently left prison or have an unspent conviction. Read more about prison leaver recruitment (opens in new window) .

title: Senior Software Engineer, MTI
description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

What you will be working on

As a Software Engineer, you will take on meaningful ownership of features and technical work that spans multiple components of our products. You will work with a degree of independence while continuing to grow through mentorship, and you will play an active role in shaping the quality, reliability, and culture of the team you work in.

Craft & Execution

You will deliver features and proofs of concept that span multiple components or modules, typically working across two to three areas within your team. While you will receive mentorship on architectural decisions and cross-component integration, you are expected to make thoughtful trade-offs between performance, security, and maintainability based on your understanding of the context. You will write and review code with clarity and long‑term maintainability in mind, applying good engineering practices consistently, and you will expand test coverage — including unit and integration tests — to support key workflows and reduce flakiness.

Beyond feature delivery, you will address pockets of technical debt within your domain, suggest improvements that enhance product performance or team velocity, and contribute to CI/CD processes and deployment pipelines. You will also take a deliberate approach to balancing short‑term delivery speed with long‑term code health, flagging when quick fixes introduce future risk, and applying organisational platform and compliance standards effectively.

After your work ships, you are expected to follow through on its impact — checking metrics, reviewing error rates, and addressing post‑deployment issues proactively. You will actively participate in incident triage and resolution with team support, and you will escape complex issues when needed.

You will also bring rigour to the use of AI‑generated code, reviewing it for correctness, edge cases, security issues, and maintainability to the same standard as any human‑authored contribution. Writing clear task descriptions and specifications to get higher‑quality AI assistance and reduce rework is part of how you work.

Ownership

You will independently own your assigned tasks and projects, identifying and addressing issues proactively with minimal guidance. You will know when to seek help and from whom, and you will look for opportunities to recommend improvements to processes or outcomes within your own work.

Strategic Alignment

You will align your work with your team's goals and priorities, focusing on tasks that deliver the most expected business value. You will adapt to changing priorities independently, without needing to be redirected.

Culture and Organisational Influence

You will collaborate with peers and stakeholders to ensure work is executed effectively, address minor conflicts constructively and respectfully, and suggest improvements that enhance team effectiveness. You will share knowledge, resources, successes, and failures openly — because you understand that team success depends on everyone having the information they need.

What we are looking for

  • Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Strong software engineering experience building and operating production‑grade applications
  • Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Java, Go, Python, or TypeScript
  • Experience with modern application architectures, APIs, cloud platforms, container technologies, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Solid understanding of software design, testing strategies, application security, and system reliability
  • Experience working in cross‑functional product teams and collaborating effectively with technical and non‑technical stakeholders
  • Strong problem‑solving skills, sound technical judgement, and the ability to navigate ambiguity
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor others, influence engineering decisions, and improve team practices
  • Experience building enterprise or internal productivity tools, workflow systems, or staff‑facing platforms will be an advantage
  • Familiarity with data, automation, or AI‑enabled features for enterprise products will be an advantage

This role is well suited for an engineer who combines strong technical depth with product thinking, and who is motivated by building practical tools that make day‑to‑day work simpler, faster, and better for colleagues across the organisation.

Please note that this will be a 2‑year fixed term contract.

What we offer you

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market‑competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work‑life needs and employee wellness programs.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers.

Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

title: Advanced Packaging Intern, MS - Summer 2027
description:
About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

The Marvell Advanced Packaging team is responsible for supporting customers with package designs that meet challenging electrical requirements. High speed signaling and challenging power delivery networks require complex and custom solutions to meet constantly advancing application needs. Many of the new designs require multi-chip and multiple component configurations with high-speed IP requirements. In addition, our team is advancing Marvell's expertise in 3D packaging, Co-packaged optics and cutting-edge substrate materials. We work with the world's leading manufacturers to solve our client's most challenging designs and integrations with industry-leading packaging techniques.

What You Can Expect

  • Perform signal integrity (SI), power integrity (PI), and electromagnetic (EM) simulations for advanced packaging and high-speed interconnects.

  • Evaluate package and PCB designs to ensure electrical performance requirements are met.

  • Analyze power distribution networks (PDNs) and high-speed channels to identify and resolve signal and power delivery issues.

  • Execute simulation and verification activities supporting SI/PI sign-off.

  • Collaborate with package design, layout, hardware, and IP teams to optimize electrical performance.

  • Develop scripts and automation tools using Python, MATLAB, or similar tools to improve analysis workflows.

  • Document results and present technical findings to cross-functional engineering teams.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate will have an interest in hardware design and experience working on signal and power integrity verification and design optimization. A knowledge of Electrical Engineering concepts, circuit extractions and simulation, as well as design methodology and strategies is required.

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's Degree program studying Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, with an expected graduation date between Fall 2027 – Summer 2028.

  • Strong interest in hardware design and strong understanding of electromagnetic fundamentals, signal integrity concepts and circuit simulation techniques.

  • Knowledge of circuit simulation techniques and experience evaluating electrical behavior of package, PCB, or interconnect structures.

  • Exposure to frequency-domain and time-domain analysis methodologies.

  • Experience with electrical simulation tools for signal integrity, power integrity, or electromagnetic analysis.

  • Ability to organize technical information, analyze data, document results, and communicate findings effectively.

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work with engineers across multiple disciplines, teams, and locations.

  • Interest in hardware design, advanced packaging technologies, and design optimization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating package or PCB designs for challenging electrical requirements.

  • Hands-on experience with 2-D/3-D electromagnetic simulation tools such as Ansys HFSS, SIwave, Cadence Clarity, or similar tools.

  • Experience performing signal integrity (SI), power integrity (PI), channel analysis, power distribution network (PDN) analysis, or related simulation activities.

  • Familiarity with advanced packaging technologies, including 2.5D and 3D packaging architectures.

  • Experience collaborating with physical designers, layout engineers, or IP teams to optimize electrical performance.

  • Familiarity with IC package design and layout tools such as Cadence APD or equivalent.

  • Proficiency in MATLAB, Python, or other scripting languages for data analysis, automation, or workflow development.

  • Strong presentation, documentation, and technical communication skills.

Expected Base Pay Range (USD)

37 - 73, $ per hour.

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.


This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.


Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements

Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights for our interns: medical, dental, and vision coverage, perks and discounts, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and paid holidays. Additional compensation may be available for intern PhD candidates. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Mobile Phone Repair Technician- East London
description:
Mobile Phone Repair Technician

£27,109.31 - £27,325.83 + commission
Location: East London

Overview of Position

Experience with gadgets, repairs, and helping people out?

At iSmash, we rescue customers from the panic of shattered screens, dead batteries, charging issues and much more. We understand how frustrating it feels when your device stops working. That’s why we connect with our customers on a personal level, put them at ease, and provide fast, reliable repairs that get them back online quickly.

We’re looking for someone who is customer focused, hands-on, and confident working with smartphones, tablets and mobile devices in a fast-paced retail environment. This role suits someone who enjoys technology, has a strong eye for detail, and is comfortable carrying out high-quality device repairs while delivering great customer service.

This role reports to the In-Store Manager.

What makes us different?

At iSmash, we combine technical expertise with genuine customer care. We don’t just fix devices; we create a reassuring and positive experience for every customer who walks through our doors.

Since opening in 2013, we’ve grown to 37 shops across the UK and continue to expand. We’re proud to offer a lifetime warranty on screen repairs, giving customers confidence in the quality of our work.

iSmash is part of Assurant, Inc., a Fortune 300 company and global leader supporting over 300 million consumers worldwide. Together, we’re building a trusted, innovative business in the connected world.

We also pride ourselves on our supportive, collaborative culture, focused on helping our people grow and succeed.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • You will play a key role in delivering high-quality repairs and excellent customer experiences.
  • Repair smartphones and tablets, including screen replacements, battery replacements, camera repairs, charging issues and other common faults
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot device issues using your technical judgement
  • Provide clear advice and guidance to customers on repair options and solutions
  • Recommend suitable accessories and protection products
  • Maintain a clean, organised and safe workspace
  • Follow repair standards and safety guidelines at all times

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Proven experience repairing smartphones and tablets, particularly brands such as Apple, Samsung and Google
  • Strong customer service skills with confidence speaking directly to customers
  • High attention to detail when handling devices, tools and small components
  • A genuine interest in mobile technology, gadgets and repairs
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced retail environment

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Previous experience in a retail or customer-facing environment
  • Experience recommending products or upselling accessories
  • A willingness to learn and develop new repair techniques
  • A proactive attitude and ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Benefits

  • £27,109.31 - £27,325.83 basic salary plus commission
  • Personalised career development and ongoing training opportunities
  • Company pension and increasing holiday allowance with service
  • 21 days’ holiday plus 8 bank holidays
  • Opportunity for relocation support where applicable
  • A supportive, fun culture with recognition and annual awards

About iSmash

iSmash is the place to go for fast, reliable repairs of smartphones, tablets and computers. We also offer a wide range of mobile accessories and refurbished devices.

This job posting supports our ongoing talent pipeline for current and future opportunities. Suitable candidates will be contacted as roles become available.

At iSmash and Assurant, we value diversity and inclusion. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected and supported.

Ready to make a difference? Join us and help create a world without #techstress.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?
Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

title: Head of Client Performance
description:
Role: Head of Client Performance
Location: Old Trafford, Manchester, M16 0PQ
Hours: 8.45am - 5.15pm (Monday to Friday)
Package: Up to £90,000 OTE

As Head of Client Performance, your role is to lead the evolution of PHMG's client model, creating a Partner Services proposition that delivers greater client value, deeper product adoption and stronger long-term relationships.

This is a transformation leadership role. You will help define the vision for Partner Services, translate it into a practical operating model and lead the cross-functional change required to deliver it.

A separate transformation focus exists around client activation and onboarding, but the client experience must operate as one connected journey. You will therefore work closely with the Head of Client Performance (Activation), with both roles expected to lean into each other's areas where the client outcome requires it.

The role requires the mindset and experience of a senior management consultant: able to move between strategy and execution, structure complex problems, facilitate senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and create momentum across organisational boundaries.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the vision, design and delivery of PHMG’s transformation from Client Services to Partner Services
  • Define the future Partner Services operating model, ensuring it creates measurable value for clients and the business
  • Build and deliver a clear transformation roadmap, establishing priorities, ownership, investment requirements and measures of success
  • Take an end-to-end view of the client journey, ensuring onboarding, activation and ongoing Partner Services operate as a connected experience
  • Design a scalable Partner Services model that combines Partner Manager ownership, specialist expertise, technology, automation and proactive service
  • Define how the client experience should vary according to client needs, value, complexity, product portfolio and maturity
  • Establish how PHMG creates, demonstrates and increases client value through stronger engagement, product adoption, optimisation and specialist support
  • Use client, commercial, operational and product insight to identify opportunities, prioritise improvements and measure the impact of transformation activity
  • Develop and test new Partner Services propositions and commercial opportunities through structured pilots and evidence-led decision making
  • Lead cross-functional transformation across Client Services, Product, Creative, Technology, Data, Operations, Finance, Sales and Commercial teams, creating alignment and accountability without relying on direct authority

Key Requirements:

  • Experience in management consulting, transformation consulting, corporate strategy or a comparable enterprise transformation role
  • Proven experience designing target operating models and leading complex, cross-functional transformation programmes
  • Strong strategic, analytical and commercial capability, with experience translating strategy into practical implementation
  • Experience developing business cases, transformation roadmaps and measurable success criteria
  • Confidence influencing, facilitating and constructively challenging senior stakeholders across multiple functions
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to bring structure to ambiguity and operate effectively between senior-level strategy and operational detail

What you’ll get in return:

  • Free PureGym membership after 3-months served
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • 23 days annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing with length of service
  • Additional half day off for birthday
  • Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
  • Two volunteer days per year for a charity of your choice
  • Smart pension scheme
  • Life insurance and critical illness cover
  • All expenses paid company events in sought after venues
  • Free fruit & breakfast
  • Company sports teams
  • On-site barber and beautician
  • Car valet service
  • Career development directly linked to your performance
  • Fundraising initiatives for our registered charity – the PHMG Foundation
  • Dedicated Employee Assistance Programme

About PHMG:

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a Manchester-founded creative business into the world’s leading audio branding agency. Today, we partner with almost 40,000 clients across more than 50 countries, including global brands such as Coca-Cola, Samsung, Adidas and Audi, alongside ambitious SMEs in virtually every sector. Innovation fuels everything we do. From day one, we set out to redefine audio branding by harmonising creativity, technology and measurable results. That mindset continues to shape our evolution as we expand beyond sound into a broader suite of client communication services. In 2025, PHMG entered a defining new chapter as an employee-owned business. Ownership now sits with the people who power our creativity, performance and growth. It strengthens our independence, sharpens our long-term focus and ensures success is shared. We are proud recipients of the King’s Award for Enterprise, recognised for innovation, growth and performance excellence. Today, more than 800 colleagues across six global offices collaborate to deliver work that blends artistry with commercial impact. Joining PHMG means becoming part of a people-powered, future-focused company that values creativity, champions diversity and invests in professional growth. Sound good?

20. Count down drawer at end of shift and prepare final drop.
21. Answer questions and provide information to guests.

29. Fulfill responsibilities with care and attention to detail.
30. Practice teamwork and cooperation with others.
31. Possess time management skills and be able to prioritize tasks.
32. Ability to manage stress in a fast-paced environment.

and/or pull 50-100 pounds or more occasionally. Communicate with and understand team members and guests. See product and payment methods.
34. Work in accordance with all safety regulations of Specs Family Partners and OSHA.
35. Other projects and tasks assigned by management.

36. Attendance and timeliness are required. It is hard to run the register from home.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty listed above satisfactorily. State law says you must be over the age of 21 to work at Spec's. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. In other words, here's the technical stuff.
Education or Experience
We'd prefer you to have cashiering experience, but if you're willing to learn, we're willing to teach you. We'd like you to have a high school diploma or a general education degree (GED), but sometimes, experience is the best education.
Language Skills
We need you to be able to read, comprehend, and write simple instructions or memos. You must be able to communicate with and understand coworkers and guests. Bilingual skills are a plus.
Mathematical Skills
You need the ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in both whole numbers and in fractions and decimals without taking your shoes off. You need to be able to calculate discounts and percentages. We can provide a calculator.
Demeanor and Personal Skills Smiley, Friendly, Helpful
You've got the job. Now you need to do the job. You need to be responsible, reliable, and committed to providing extraordinary service. Patience, friendliness, and an outgoing personality are needed for success. You need to be a self-starter with a strong work ethic who completes job assignments in a timely fashion and then looks for the next task.
Hours
Full-time is typically 35 hours per week. Must be available to work any shift on Friday or Saturday and must be available 80% or more of all shifts each week.
Part-time is up to 25 hours per week.
We schedule for the needs of our business. Working outside of your scheduled time without District Manager approval is prohibited and subject to discipline. In other words, you cannot decide to make up hours because you missed some time after a night out with your buddies unless your District Manager ok's it.
Reasoning Ability
You need the ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
Certificates, Licenses
You must maintain a valid TABC Beverage Sellers Permit and in some cases, a valid Food Handlers Permit. The TABC course takes 2-3 hours to complete, and we will pay you for your time spent in the course up to 3 hours. Spec's will provide a link to the course and login information after the hiring process is complete. We will deduct the cost of the course from your paycheck.

Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals who need them to perform the essential functions. This job regularly requires standing, walking, and bending; use of arms, hands, and fingers to feel, handle, reach, and lift; climbing and balance; communicating and understanding. You must be able to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds regularly and
up to 50 pounds or more occasionally using proper lifting techniques and tools. You must be able to push and/or pull 50-100 pounds or more occasionally. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. This job also requires physical attendance based on a schedule made by management which may vary week to week based on the needs of the business.
Work Environment and Environmental Conditions
We provide a fun and positive environment in which to serve our guests. You may be exposed to outside weather conditions while youre delivering extraordinary service. The noise level is usually moderate.

description:
About the Position: The Associate Legislative Director for Health leads the advancement of NACo’s advocacy priorities by designing and executing federal policy strategies for NACo’s work in public health and healthy communities, including disease and injury prevention and health promotion, health disparities reduction, mental and behavioral health services, and financing delivering health care. This role drives NACo’s agenda by developing and implementing legislative and regulatory initiatives, engaging directly with Capitol Hill and the Administration, analyzing policy proposals, and preparing high-impact materials for members and stakeholders. This position reports for NACo’s Chief Government Affairs Officer.

In addition, the Associate Legislative Director leads committee meetings, educational sessions, and workshops held during NACo conferences, while providing oversight and guidance to legislative assistants or associates.

Key Responsibilities

• Leads the development and execution of comprehensive advocacy and legislative strategies in support of county health priorities, aligning priorities with the American County Platform and NACo’s strategic policy agenda

• Demonstrates a deep understanding of the federal legislative and regulatory landscape, including budget, appropriations, and administrative processes, to shape and influence outcomes on behalf of counties

• Serves as NACo’s chief advocate on issues related to health, driving federal outreach and direct engagement with Congress and federal agencies to advance county priorities and influence legislative and regulatory decisions

• Advises county officials and senior NACo leadership on emerging policy trends, strategic positioning and the implications of federal actions.

• Prepares testimony, comment letters, policy briefs, legislative analysis and other high-impact advocacy materials

• Leads member engagement for the Health Steering Committee, elevating county-led initiatives at the federal level and strengthening intergovernmental partnerships between counties, Congress and the Administration to advance shared priorities.

• Leads the planning, content development and execution of policy briefings, Steering Committee meetings, Capitol Hill events and workshops at NACo conferences and other events throughout the year, ensuring strategic alignment and strong member and stakeholder participation

• Engages in external speaking roles and represents NACo in coalition meetings, convenings and public forums to elevate county perspectives, build partnerships and garner support for NACo’s advocacy priorities

• Supervises, mentors, and develops one to two legislative assistants or associates, ensuring work products reflect strategic alignment, high-quality analysis, and excellent member service

• Collaborates across NACo’s policy teams to integrate advocacy strategies, unify messaging, and identify cross-portfolio opportunities that strengthen NACo’s overall legislative impact

• Other duties as assigned


Qualifications:

• An advanced degree with a minimum of three years of professional experience in legislative or regulatory policy and advocacy or a bachelor's degree with at least five years of such experience

• Substantive experience in the federal health policy landscape

• Strong understanding of the federal legislative process and administrative rulemaking, including the federal budget and appropriations

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with the ability to distill complex policy or legal information into clear and accessible content

• Proactive, detail-oriented self-starter with the ability to anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and communicate clearly and effectively across all levels of an organization

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, bipartisan environment


Preferred Attributes:

• Experience working on Capitol Hill, in a federal agency, national member facing association

• Proven ability to build coalitions and engage effectively in government relations or policy advocacy

• Familiarity with county structures, local governance and intergovernmental relations

• Experience developing and managing a program or departmental budget


Location and Travel:

• This position is based in Washington, D.C. with opportunities to travel for conferences, meetings and stakeholder engagements

• Expected travel: approximately 25 percent of total workdays


Salary:

Annual $90,000 commensurate with experience and available resources

title: LGR Project Manager
description:
• Future Suffolk / Suffolk County Council
  • Address: Endeavour House, Ipswich, Suffolk IP1 2BX, Hybrid working
  • Salary: £48,163 - 58,850 per annum
  • Hours: 37 hours per week, flexible working options available
  • Contract: Fixed Term or Secondment until 31 March 2028

Suffolk's councils are working together on one of the most ambitious change programmes the county has ever seen. Through Local Government Reorganisation (LGR), we're creating three new unitary councils and building the foundations for the future of local services across Suffolk.

We're looking for talented people to join our programme team and play a key role in making that happen.

As one of the Project Manager’s, you'll play a key role in maintaining visibility across the programme, ensuring workstreams remain connected, informed and focused on delivery. Working across organisational boundaries, you'll help translate programme priorities into coordinated action across Suffolk's councils.

Your role and responsibilities

You'll work across several LGR workstreams, acting as the link between workstream leads and the Programme Management Office (PMO). You'll help ensure activity remains coordinated, connected and focused on delivery, while providing visibility of progress, risks, milestones and dependencies across a fast-paced and complex programme.

You will:

  • Coordinate and monitor multiple LGR workstreams simultaneously.
  • Work with workstream leads and theme sponsors to maintain clear plans, milestones, risks and dependencies.
  • Ensure workstreams understand how their activity contributes to the wider programme roadmap.
  • Identify and escalate risks, issues and barriers early, acting as the eyes and ears of the PMO.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, reporting and programme information.
  • Support workstream leads to meet reporting requirements and programme deadlines.
  • Build strong relationships across organisational boundaries and support delivery at pace.
  • Help ensure workstreams remain connected, informed and focused on programme priorities.

What you will need

We're looking for an experienced project manager who can work confidently across organisational boundaries, maintain oversight of complex activity and bring people together around shared objectives.

We hope you’ll bring:

  • Strong project management experience, ideally within organisational change, transformation or public sector programmes.
  • Experience managing multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously, with strong organisational and prioritisation skills and the ability to maintain visibility across competing priorities.
  • A strong understanding of governance, risk management, dependencies, milestone planning and reporting.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and the confidence to challenge constructively where required.
  • A good understanding of local government and the complexities of working across organisational boundaries.
  • Strong communication, influencing and relationship-building skills.
  • Resilience, initiative and a proactive, solutions-focused approach, with the ability to work at pace in an evolving environment.
  • A commitment to delivering positive outcomes for Suffolk's residents and communities, recognising how individual workstreams contribute to the wider success of the programme.

You can view a full list of requirements in the Job and Person Profile (JPP), which you can find in the ‘How to apply’ section towards the bottom of this advert.

If you believe you can succeed in this role, apply. Even if you don't meet all requirements, still apply. We would appreciate the opportunity to consider your application.

The team

Although hosted by Suffolk County Council, this is a genuinely system-wide role working across the full LGR system, bringing together multiple councils, disciplines and partners behind a single shared objective. The team act on behalf of all Suffolk councils and are accountable to the Future Suffolk Implementation Board.

You’ll join a newly established programme team, united by a shared commitment to delivering change that protects services for residents and creates strong, sustainable new councils.

For more information on LGR in Suffolk, please visit the Three Councils for Suffolk and the Future Suffolk websites.

Applications from Suffolk's five councils

Colleagues currently working for one of Suffolk's five councils are encouraged to apply. Where possible, appointments will be made on a secondment basis, allowing you to retain your substantive role.

Empowering Everyone

We’re big believers in potential, possibility and the power of different ideas. We’re always searching for ways to encourage, respect and enable everyone to be the best they can be. We want to represent the diverse communities we serve. We welcome applications from all individuals, especially those from groups that are currently underrepresented in the organisation, as shown in our Workforce Equality Report.

For more information

Please contact Lysanne Eddy, Programme Director for LGR, for a casual conversation. You can reach them by emailing lysanne.eddy@suffolk.gov.uk

How to apply

Step 1 - Read the Job and Person Profile (Word).

Step 2 - Click ‘Apply Now’ to start your online application.

Step 3 - Please upload the following to your application:

  1. An up-to-date copy of your CV
  2. A supporting statement (maximum 500 words) outlining what you would bring to the Suffolk LGR Programme and how your approach would help you succeed in a complex, multi-organisational environment.
  3. Case studies (maximum 250 words each) (up to three examples, maximum 250 words each) demonstrating where you have managed or maintained oversight of multiple projects or workstreams within a complex programme. Please include the scale and complexity of the work, your role and contribution and the outcomes achieved.

Please note: Without a supporting statement and CV, your interest will not be progressed. Any supporting documents must be in either PDF or MS Word format.

For guidance on completing your application, please see our How to Apply page.

Planning to use Artificial Intelligence (AI)? Please ensure your application still reflects your own skills, experience and ideas. If used inappropriately, your application may not be processed. Please read our guidance for using AI to understand what’s acceptable.

Do you need any reasonable adjustments to help you to apply? If you are disabled and/or have additional support needs, you can request reasonable adjustments. You can do this by contacting our Recruitment Team at recruitment@suffolk.gov.uk or 03456 014412. You can find examples of possible adjustments on our Reasonable Adjustment pages.

Provisional interview date: Week commencing 21 September 2026 (subject to change)

title: Assistant Engineer, Data Operations and Annotation
description:
Role Overview

The Data Operations and Annotation Specialist supports the data lifecycle for Data Analytics (DA), Video Analytics (VA), Computer Vision (CV) and Machine Learning (ML) projects. The role collects, organizes, labels and quality-checks UAS and sensor datasets, ensuring that data is complete, traceable and ready for model development, testing and validation.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support the collection and ingestion of image, video, telemetry, sensor, mission and test data from UAS platforms, ground control systems and related equipment.
  • Record and maintain essential metadata, including the data source, collection conditions, platform, sensor configuration, mission or test event and dataset status.
  • Organize and maintain raw, processed, annotated, training, validation and test datasets using approved naming, storage, version-control and access procedures.
  • Perform or coordinate data annotation using approved taxonomies and guidelines, including bounding boxes, polygons, masks, key points, class or event labels and timestamps.
  • Conduct first-level checks for missing or corrupted files, incomplete metadata, duplicate samples, naming inconsistencies and annotation errors.
  • Prepare and release traceable dataset packages for model training, evaluation, system testing, validation, demonstrations and engineering review.
  • Maintain dataset registers, annotation status, version and release records, handover notes and known-issue logs.
  • Support laboratory tests, flight tests, field trials and demonstrations where data collection or data handling is required.
Requirements
  • Working knowledge of file management, dataset organization, digital storage and spreadsheets or equivalent tracking tools.
  • Ability to handle large image, video, telemetry or sensor datasets accurately and systematically.
  • Familiarity with data annotation tools and common annotation methods such as boxes, polygons, masks, labels or event tags.
  • Ability to follow technical instructions, naming conventions, annotation guidelines and data-handling procedures.
  • Good attention to detail, organizational ability and communication skills.
  • Ability to identify data-quality issues and escape unclear or technically ambiguous cases to the relevant engineer.
  • Willingness to support field tests, demonstrations and data-collection activities when required.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience supporting AI, ML, computer vision, video analytics, robotics, UAS or other sensor-based projects.
  • Experience handling data from laboratory tests, field trials, flight tests or demonstrations.
  • Experience with data annotation platforms such as CVAT, Label Studio, Roboflow, Supervisely, VGG Image Annotator or equivalent tools.
  • Experience maintaining dataset metadata, annotation status, version histories or release records.
  • Experience with video, telemetry, image, geospatial or multi-sensor datasets.
What You Will Deliver
  • Complete and traceable datasets with the required metadata.
  • Consistently annotated and first-level quality-checked data.
  • Up-to-date dataset, version, annotation and release records.
  • Controlled dataset packages and handover information for engineering use.

title: Managing Director, Information Technology
description:
About the Position

The Managing Director of Information Technology plays a critical role in shaping and executing NACo’s long-term technology strategy in alignment with the organization’s mission and priorities. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this role leads the IT function and is responsible for infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, and data management.

This position requires a strategic leader who can drive innovation while ensuring reliable day-to-day operations. The Managing Director will guide NACo’s use of cloud platforms, data, and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, to improve internal operations and member services. The role also serves as a key advisor to senior leadership on technology investments, risks, and opportunities.


Key Responsibilities:

Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute a multi-year technology roadmap aligned with NACo’s mission and organizational goals
  • Serve as a strategic partner to senior leadership, ensuring technology supports operational and member-facing priorities
  • Lead digital transformation efforts, including responsible adoption of AI and automation
  • Establish clear priorities, performance expectations, and accountability within the IT team
  • Foster a culture of service, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Technology & Innovation

  • Identify, evaluate, and deploy emerging technologies, including AI-powered tools to improve internal workflows and member-facing services
  • Guide the responsible use of AI tools, including governance, risk management, and appropriate use standards
  • Partner with internal teams to improve systems and workflows
  • Ensure new solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with organizational needs

Infrastructure & Systems Management

  • Oversee IT infrastructure, including cloud environments (Azure), networking, and endpoint management systems (e.g., MDM, ATP)
  • Ensure systems are secure, reliable, and scalable to support organizational growth
  • Direct the management of enterprise applications, including Microsoft Dynamics 365, the E-Index and data integration platforms
  • Maintain inventory of all materially significant technical equipment (e.g., laptops, input devices, peripherals, network equipment, digital equipment, cameras, external storage devices, etc.)

Data & Enterprise Applications

  • Develop and govern NACo’s data strategy to strengthen analytics, reporting and data-driven decision-making across the organization
  • Ensure data integrity, accuracy and effective integration across enterprise systems
  • Partner with NACo departments to align technology systems with operational needs and improve efficiency

Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance

  • Lead NACo’s cybersecurity program aligned with recognized frameworks such as NIST or CIS Oversee risk management, disaster recovery and business continuity planning
  • Conduct annual penetration testing and vulnerability assessments to ensure the integrity of NACo’s cybersecurity defenses and identify areas for improvement
  • Lead annual tabletop exercises to simulate potential cybersecurity incidents and test NACo’s incident response and business continuity plans
  • Ensure the organization remains compliant with industry standards while proactively addressing emerging security challenges
  • Oversee third-party and vendor security considerations

Vendor & Financial Management

  • Establish and manage strategic vendor partnerships and oversee contract negotiations to optimize service quality and cost
  • Establish standards for technology procurement and evaluation
  • Develop and manage the IT budget to optimize performance, cost-efficiency and value

Additional Responsibilities

  • Oversee the technical integration of all NACo software applications and partners with unit business owners on their procurement and maintenance of these systems to ensure compliance with NACo software and development standards
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field (Master’s preferred)
  • 8-10 or more years of progressive IT leadership experience Experience leading technology strategy and digital transformation
  • Proven ability to align technology strategies with organizational mission and OKRs, driving innovation and operational excellence
  • Deep knowledge in IT infrastructure, cybersecurity frameworks, cloud platforms (Azure) and enterprise data management (D365)
  • Expertise in managing cybersecurity risk, regulatory compliance and implementing proactive threat management solutions
  • Skilled in leveraging data analytics and governance to support member services, organizational insights and decision-making processes
  • Ability to collaborate across departments and with senior leadership to ensure that technology initiatives contribute directly to NACo’s top-line objectives
  • Experience managing IT budgets, vendors and cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Attributes:

  • Experience managing teams of 5 or more IT professionals
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform
  • Proven track record in association, membership, or government/public sector organizations
  • Strong communication skills with ability to present technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and board leadership
  • Ability and willingness to travel to support NACo conferences and events


Location and Travel:
This position is located in Washington, D.C. but eligible for a hybrid work schedule and requires travel for NACo conferences, meetings and partner engagements.

Salary Range: $170,000 - $185,000 commensurate with experience and available resources

title: Senior RF Engineer (Indoor)

About The Role
As a Senior RF Engineer, the candidate will support the design, deployment and optimisation of our wireless mobile solutions across the HS2 project.   • Create low level designs including Bills of Materials, cable schedules and detailed system configuration diagrams, ensuring costs are closely controlled throughout the design process.
  • Understand the wider context of the design and ensure external interfaces are considered working with other team members to implement an integrated design.
  • Ensure designs are dimensioned for current demand and scalable to adapt for future growth and changes in MNO requirements.

  • Liaise with customers, presenting designs to clients, stakeholders and project teams.
  • Complete any Handover Packs, Post Integration Reports and Design Reports on agreed timescales and report templates
  • Provide estimates on resources required for particular tasks.
  • Updating any internal reporting system as required.
  • Familiarisation of all company documentation, especially ISO procedures.

This role requires 2 days per week located in Birmingham.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience designing indoor coverage solutions including active and passive distributed antenna systems (DAS) especially for large scale high-capacity venues such as major train stations.
  • Minimum iBwave certification level 2 (level 3 preferred).
  • Knowledge of UK or IE mobile network architecture models and standards.
  • Experience of designing DAS equipment rooms, including MNO equipment requirements, dimensioning DAS head end, and defining electrical and cooling loads.
  • Knowledge of working with architects & BIM modelling teams to plan spacial co-ordination of equipment.
  • Experience of testing methodologies, test tools such as scanners and test phones (TEMS, NEMO etc).
  • Advanced knowledge in optimisation and performance optimisation.
  • Good knowledge of Radio Link Budgets.

Why work with us?

We’re large enough to deliver and maintain large-scale operations, giving you the opportunity to work on exciting projects and expand your skills. You’ll be surrounded talented colleagues who thrive on solving problems, just like you. Together, you’ll make your mark on projects that matter and find new strengths along the way.

We also offer:

  • Flexible working opportunities
  • Parental leave with up to 20 weeks paid at full salary
  • Holiday allowance starting at 25 days rising with length of service
  • 4 days off each year to volunteer

Ready to apply? Are you ready to create an impact that will last for generations? Join us at Boldyn Networks today. Hit apply and follow the instructions to get started.

Diversity recognises the ways we differ. Our backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. What makes us unique. And it’s important to us, to our future. To build a workforce that’s representative of the societies we serve. So that we can listen, learn and understand how to solve our customers’ problems in the smartest ways possible.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Job Title Enterprise Architect
Role Support Functions
Expertise Support - IT
Job Location London
Description

We have an exciting opportunity for an Enterprise Architect to join our IT team. In this newly created role, the Enterprise Architect will bridge the gap between business requirements and technology by expanding the firm's overarching technical architecture.

The Enterprise Architect designs and oversees the implementation of scalable, secure, and well-governed solutions and platforms across our core technology stack, spanning practice management, document management, cloud platforms, security, and emerging technology including AI.

Embedded within our Business Solutions Team, the role works across the whole of IT, collaborating closely with Infrastructure, Information Security, Business Solutions, Legal Tech, Data Architecture and Insights, Finance Systems and our Project Management Office to ensure solutions and platforms are designed from the ground up with our full estate in mind.

They will analyse requirements, evaluate infrastructure, platforms and solutions, and propose and create scalable, secure designs that integrate the firm's existing systems and meet the firm's goals. This includes major platforms such as iManage, Intapp Open, Intapp Time, Aderant, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, endpoint devices and Netskope, alongside the responsible adoption of AI where it safely and securely delivers genuine value.

This role is for a forward-thinking technologist who is passionate about both established and emerging technology, understands how enterprise systems interoperate, embraces AI where appropriate, and has a drive to deliver a seamless user experience.

Bird & Bird's Technology Team mission is to support the strong technology focus of the Firm, provide modern technology to support the business and creative solutions for our Clients.

In London, the team comprises 50 technology staff covering a broad range of technologies and specialisms including business architecture, business solutions, project and programme management, modern infrastructure and they are all primarily focused on international projects working alongside colleagues in our 34 offices.Whether it's analysing new solutions, driving innovation, developing client solutions or providing a first class, high availability infrastructure and support we are a diverse, energised group focused on service and contributing to both the internal and external use of technologies. We work extensively across the network and seek candidates who are keen to engage internationally and make wider contributions both internally and externally than just IT service and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Solution & Platform Design: Craft the technical vision, architecture, and specifications for new systems and enhancements across the firm's core technology stack, from document and practice management through to cloud, security, and emerging technology (AI).
  • Systems Integration: Design end-to-end solutions that integrate the firm's existing enterprise systems ensuring interoperability, resilience, and a consistent user experience. You'll need to be able to work with established tools such as Power Apps, Power Automate or Tines to prototye, test and build core integrations.
  • Cloud & Migration Architecture: Shape and support major platform initiatives, such as the migration of key solutions to the cloud, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, and aligned with the firm's cloud strategy across major platforms.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work across the whole of IT, partnering with Infrastructure, Information Security, Business Solutions, Legal Tech, Data Architecture and Insights, Finance Systems and our Project Management Office to take solutions and platforms from concept through to production.
  • Business Translation: Evaluate business challenges and map out where technology, whether traditional software, integration, or AI, can yield the highest return on investment.
  • Emerging Technology (AI): Design responsible AI-enabled solutions where they add value, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), data pipelines, and agentic workflows, ensuring they mesh smoothly with existing enterprise systems.
  • Governance & Security: Ensure all designs comply with data privacy, security, responsible AI principles, and the regulatory standards specific to the legal industry.
  • Technical Leadership: Guide our passionate team and analysts through proofs-of-concept, implementation, and production roll-outs.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Translate complex business requirements into actionable technical solutions and communicate them effectively to non-technical stakeholders.

What you'll bring

  • Deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns, software development lifecycles (SDLC), and the design of microservices, APIs, and large scale enterprise-grade solutions.
  • Deep understanding of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud), including hybrid and migration architectures.
  • Experience designing and integrating solutions across enterprise line-of-business systems; familiarity with legal sector platforms such as iManage and Intapp, or comparable document, practice, and time management systems, is a strong advantage.
  • Understanding of enterprise security and access platforms (e.g. Netskope, zero trust architectures) and how they shape solution design.
  • Solid understanding of modern AI paradigms (Generative AI, agentic workflows, ML pipelines, MCP) and leading AI services (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini), with a focus on how AI interoperates with existing firm systems.
  • Strong analytical capabilities to evaluate technologies and determine the most cost-effective, scalable options.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication to negotiate, pitch ideas, and bridge the gap between engineers and executives.
  • Knowledge of data management, risk management, and the regulatory standards specific to the legal industry.

What's in it for you

We provide comprehensive support for our colleagues' health and wellbeing, including private medical cover, life assurance, critical illness cover, and regular health assessments. In addition, we offer a range of lifestyle benefits designed to help our team live their best lives, such as a cycle to work scheme, access to online GP appointments, discounted gym memberships, and an electric vehicle scheme.

Our hybrid working policy requires colleagues to bein our London office for three days per week.

If you require any assistance, please email us at talentacquisitionlondon@twobirds.com

To apply, click on the 'apply' button to submit your details.

Bird & Bird opens up a world of possible for lawyers and professionals everywhere. Working for a leading international law firm like Bird & Bird means working alongside people who are truly collegiate in the way they work with everyone. We work as one global team, with over 70% of work involving people from across the firm. And that's only increasing! It's this common purpose and shared approach that makes for a more productive and collaborative place to work. Your firm. Your future.

If you want to find out more, visit www.twobirds.com

title: Expense Analyst
description:
Job description:

About GH Logistics

GH Logistics is a family-built transportation company operating an asset-based trucking fleet and freight brokerage. We move time-critical freight for government and commercial customers across dedicated and contracted lanes.

We're growing quickly and looking for driven people who want to build processes, solve problems, and make a measurable impact.

The Opportunity

GH Logistics is building a new finance function, and we're looking for an Expense Analyst to take ownership of what happens after company money is spent.

You'll review credit card charges, bank transactions, vendor expenses, contracts, and recurring subscriptions to ensure expenses are accurate, properly categorized, and aligned with business needs.

This is a build-it role for someone who is naturally investigative, organized, and comfortable figuring things out independently.

If your instinct is to research the problem, dig into the numbers, and find the answer instead of waiting for someone to tell you what to do, you'll fit well in this position.

What You'll Do

  • Build a clean historical expense baseline by pulling and categorizing year-to-date transactions by month
  • Review transactions daily and identify unusual or questionable charges as they occur
  • Categorize company spending by department and expense type
  • Reconcile and validate expenses against supporting information and active contracts
  • Identify discrepancies and investigate the cause
  • Review recurring expenses and subscriptions to determine whether they still align with business needs
  • Analyze spending trends and identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary costs
  • Maintain organized and accurate expense records
  • Develop processes that improve ongoing visibility into company spending

What We're Looking For

Excel proficiency is the core requirement for this position.

You should be comfortable with:

  • Pivot tables
  • Lookups
  • Data reconciliation
  • Organizing and comparing large sets of information
  • Identifying discrepancies and trends

We're also looking for someone who is:

  • Independent and self-directed
  • Resourceful when information isn't immediately available
  • Detail-oriented and analytical
  • Comfortable working with financial information
  • Able to investigate problems before escalating them
  • Organized and consistent
  • Comfortable taking ownership of a new process

A college degree or accounting degree is not required.

Nice to Have

  • Google Sheets experience
  • ERP or accounting system experience
  • Expense management experience
  • Vendor reconciliation experience
  • Financial transaction review experience

Growth Opportunity

This is a brand-new position, which means you'll have the opportunity to help define how the function operates.

As GH Logistics continues to grow and transitions to a new ERP platform, this role will grow with the organization. It's a strong opportunity for someone who wants ownership, visibility, and room to develop.

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

  • Describe your Excel experience. What is the most complex task you have completed using pivot tables, lookups, or data reconciliation?
  • You identify a recurring company charge and cannot determine whether the service is still being used. You reach out to the appropriate person but receive no response. What would you do next?
  • Are you available to work on-site in San Antonio, TX, Monday–Friday from 7:30 AM–5:00 PM?

Work Location: In person
