title: Dental Director
description:
Title: Dental Director

FLSA Category: Exempt

Reports To: Chief Medical Officer (CMO)


Greater Baden Medical Services (GBMS) is a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) dedicated to providing high-quality healthcare across Southern Maryland. With 9 clinical sites located throughout Prince George's, Charles, and St. Mary's counties, we serve over 18,000 patients every year. We provide fully integrated care that includes primary care, pediatrics, women's health, Title X family planning, dental care, behavioral health, WIC, pharmacy services, and the Ryan White HIV/AIDS program. Our patient population is primarily made up of Medicaid and uninsured individuals. We are deeply proud to deliver these vital services to everyone in our community regardless of their ability to pay, making Greater Baden an incredibly rewarding place to grow your career while making a tangible, life-changing impact every day.

Job Summary:

Responsible for providing patient care as appropriate in the clinical setting, for dental health management, coordination of services with other agencies, clinical tracking of special population groups. The Dental Director ensures that the patient has access to care and the quality of care aligns with organizational priorities and goals. The Dental Director provides oversight and support to all activities or duties required to assure optimal patient oral health and dental services. In partnership with executive leadership, the Dental Director develops and implements strategies to expand access to oral healthcare services, improve patient experience and clinical outcomes, optimize operational efficiency, and support the recruitment, development, and retention of a high-performing dental team


Essential Functions & Responsibilities

1. Executive & Strategic Leadership

  • Serve as the primary oral health champion and clinical subject matter expert for GBMS, representing the Dental Division to internal leadership and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with executive and clinical leaders to develop, execute, and monitor strategic initiatives that expand access to dental care across all three clinic sites.
  • Work closely with Clinical Operations Managers, Center Managers, and the Dental Practice Manager to optimize operational efficiency, patient workflow, scheduling, and clinical coverage.
  • Contribute to grant writing, program development, and budget/resource planning for oral health programs.
  • Present dental department processes, outcomes, and performance metrics to executive leadership, the Board of Directors, and external partners as required.

2. Clinical Supervision, Staff Management & Development

  • Provide direct supervision, mentorship, and continuous performance feedback to Dentists, Dental Hygienists, and Dental Support Staff across all sites.
  • Partner with leadership to oversee the training, competency development, and career growth of Dental Assistants.
  • Lead regular, structured departmental meetings to align team goals, review clinical protocols, and foster multisite collaboration.
  • Lead the Dental Division’s peer review process in partnership with the CMO to ensure timely clinical assessments, constructive feedback, and tracked outcomes.
  • Oversee staff credentialing requirements, clinical onboarding, and professional development.

3. Operations, Quality Improvement & Compliance

  • Lead and integrate the Dental Division into organizational Quality Improvement (QI) and Performance Improvement (PI) initiatives.
  • Partner with the Infection Control and Quality teams to maintain strict oversight of sterilization protocols, equipment maintenance, infection control standards, and health hazard elimination.
  • Manage administrative and vendor relationships with dental laboratories, equipment suppliers, and 3rd-party partners.
  • Coordinate with operations teams to analyze patient satisfaction data, resolve clinical grievances, and continuously improve the patient experience.
  • Ensure full compliance with Joint Commission standards, OSHA, HIPAA, state licensing boards, and local/federal healthcare regulations.

4. Direct Patient Care & Clinical Practice

  • Provide comprehensive, high-quality direct dental care in accordance with organizational protocols and community health plans.
  • Diagnose and treat diseases, injuries, and malformations of the teeth, gums, and oral structures.
  • Perform restorative procedures, extractions, endodontic therapy, prosthodontics (e.g., dentures/models), sealants, and preventative treatments.
  • Administer local anesthetics safely and prescribe appropriate pharmacological interventions.
  • Review and interpret diagnostic X-rays and clinical tests to formulate accurate treatment plans.
  • Educate patients on oral hygiene, diet, fluoride use, and preventative oral health strategies.
  • Maintain complete, timely, and accurate patient records in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system, including encounter forms, chart notes, and insurance consultation/referral documentation.

Non-Essential / Secondary Responsibilities

  • Serve as a clinical resource to multidisciplinary teams, supporting integrated care models between primary care, pediatrics, and dental services.
  • Assist the Safety Officer with employee health initiatives, particularly regarding bloodborne pathogen exposure protocols.
  • Coordinate with specialized dental practitioners or external medical agencies when complex patient care requires specialized referral.
  • Participate in health fairs, community outreach events, and local oral health awareness programs.
  • Perform other clinical or administrative duties as assigned by the Chief Medical Officer to ensure optimal patient outcomes.

Qualifications & Credentials

Education & Licensure

  • D.D.S. or D.M.D. from an accredited dental school.
  • Active, unrestricted license to practice dentistry in the State of Maryland (or eligible for licensure).
  • Active Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) registration and Maryland State Controlled Substance license.
  • Current CPR/BLS Certification.

Experience & Competencies

  • 10 years of clinical practice experience; experience in a Community Health Center (FQHC) or public health setting strongly required.
  • 5-7 years of clinical leadership, supervisory, or management experience required.
  • Proven ability to lead multi-site teams and manage cross-departmental relationships.
  • Strong familiarity with Joint Commission accreditation standards, infection control protocols, and quality improvement frameworks.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and team-building skills.

Supervisory Responsibility

  1. Dental Hygienist
  2. Dental Assistants
  3. Students, interns, fellows and the like

Dental Division Lead Responsibilities

1. General Dentists

Travel

Must be able to drive between Greater Baden Medical Services, Inc. locations

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. The Principal Propulsion Engineer will our Conceptual Design and Flight Performance team. This position will be at our Propulsion Systems Division facility located in Promontory, UT with periodic assignments at our Bacchus (Magna), UT location.

This position will work a 9/80 schedule, with every other Friday off.

  • Develop new concepts for use in marketing, proposal, and programmatic efforts that help shape the future of our business

Why you? You’re the candidate we’re searching for if you are ready to achieve the impossible alongside like-minded innovators.

title: Regional Program Director, Public Promise Ins
description:
About Public Promise Insurance Agency

Public Promise Insurance Agency (PPI) is the insurance and employee benefits affiliate of the National Association of Counties (NACo)—the only national organization representing America’s 3,069 county governments. Built on NACo’s trusted reputation and extensive network of county leaders, PPI delivers innovative, member-focused insurance and workforce solutions designed specifically for county governments. Our portfolio helps counties strengthen employee recruitment, retention, financial wellness, and healthcare affordability while improving the overall value delivered to public servants. Joining PPI means becoming part of an entrepreneurial, mission-driven organization backed by one of the most respected brands in local government. Every conversation begins with the credibility of NACo and the opportunity to create lasting value for county governments nationwide.

About the Position:

The Regional Program Director serves as the senior field representative for Public Promise Insurance Agency within an assigned multi-state territory. This highly visible role is responsible for developing trusted relationships with county government leaders, identifying strategic opportunities, and expanding participation in PPI’s portfolio of workforce solutions. This is not a traditional sales position. It is a consultative role focused on helping counties address some of their most pressing workforce challenges, including healthcare affordability, employee financial wellness, talent recruitment and retention, and organizational resilience. Leveraging NACo’s unparalleled reputation and relationships, the Regional Program Director will engage County Executives, County Administrators, Commissioners, Human Resources Directors, Finance Officers, Risk Managers, and state association leaders to understand their priorities and deliver meaningful solutions that improve outcomes for county governments and their employees.   • Share market insights that influence future product development and organizational strategy
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and exceptional member service

  • Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in strategic business development, relationship management, consulting, public affairs, or executive account management
  • Demonstrated success building executive-level relationships and influencing organizational decision-makers

  • Highly self-motivated with the ability to independently manage a multi-state territory

The Regional Program Director will be evaluated on the ability to:

  • Generate and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified strategic opportunities
  • Achieve annual revenue and membership growth objectives

title: Cyber Threat Management Analyst, Specialist
description:
Job Title

Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst

The Role

The Cyber Threat Intelligence Center provides timely situational awareness, conducts deep analysis of threats and vulnerabilities, and extracts actionable information for relevant teams. Stakeholders include cyber-security response teams, internal lines of business, leadership, and external organizations such industry peers and intelligence sharing partners.

In this role you will

  • Collect, analyze, and correlate cyber threat intelligence from open sources (OSINT), commercial, and government sources

  • Actively monitor the threat landscape to synthesize and disseminate critical insights to relevant stakeholders

  • Conduct tactical and operational threat analysis in support of ongoing campaigns, identifying new TTPs and vulnerabilities for analysis and detection opportunities

  • Assist leadership in tracking threat actors, vulnerability exploitation, and other emerging and novel TTPs relevant to Vanguard’s technology footprint

  • Produce actionable reports, briefings, and indicators of compromise (IOCs) for internal stakeholders

  • Possess critical thinking and problem-solving abilities to find solutions, extrapolate salient artifacts, and identify correlations in threat data

  • Escalate critical or important findings to managers in a timely manner with appropriate risk analysis

  • Exercise independent judgment in methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results while also assessing the intelligence output of more junior analysts prior to dissemination

  • Work with hunt and analysis teams to assist with contextualizing the threat and facilitating the identification, mitigation, and containment of cyber-security incidents

  • Draft well-written analytical assessments and provide briefings to the team on key issues and provide editorial guidance to more junior analysts related to their output

What it takes

  • Experience working in a SOC or cyber operations environment

  • Knowledge of current and emerging cyber adversaries and their techniques, tactics, and procedures (TTPs)

  • Knowledge of a Cyber Threat Intelligence Platform, feed integrations, and security/process orchestration and automation

  • Knowledge of threat modelling and adversary tactics and techniques frameworks, such as MITRE ATT&CK matrices, Cyber Kill Chain, ACH

  • Knowledge of Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS), CVE analysis, adversary exploitation techniques, attack surface management

  • Proficiency in cybersecurity tools and techniques, as well as knowledge of common cyber threats and attack vectors.

  • Understanding of current cybersecurity trends, threats, and concepts

  • Ability to write succinct briefings, presentations, and reports to convey analysis, threat trends, threat actor profiles, indicator bulletins, vulnerability details and defensive strategies to varied audiences

Special Factors

  • Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position

  • This is a hybrid position and would require you to work in the office 3 days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday)

  • Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close this role early if there is a high level of interest. To avoid missing out, we recommend applying as soon as possible

Why Vanguard?

Vanguard is a different kind of investment company. It was founded in the United States in 1975 on a simple but revolutionary idea: that an investment company should manage its funds solely in the interests of its clients.

This is a philosophy that has helped millions of people around the world to achieve their goals with low-cost, uncomplicated investments.

It's what we stand for: value to investors.

Inclusion Statement

Vanguard’s continued commitment to diversity and inclusion is firmly rooted in our culture. Every decision we make to best serve our clients, crew (internally employees are referred to as crew), and communities is guided by one simple statement: “Do the right thing.”

We believe that a critical aspect of doing the right thing requires building diverse, inclusive, and highly effective teams of individuals who are as unique as the clients they serve. We empower our crew to contribute their distinct strengths to achieving Vanguard’s core purpose through our values.

When all crew members feel valued and included, our ability to collaborate and innovate is amplified, and we are united in delivering on Vanguard's core purpose: to take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

description:

Job Summary:

  10. Reviews current visit charges and outstanding balances with the responsible party and arranges required payments. Inputs payments and prints receipt. Schedules return appointments.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Summary:

The Development and Operations Engineer (DevOps) will be responsible for providing expert-level knowledge and support for SaaS infrastructure and cloud platforms, with a focus on AWS, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Kuberenetes, IaC, CaC and general infrastructure and systems, such as load balancers, proxies, DNS, networking, hybrid, and storage. The DevOps Engineer will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining SaaS infrastructure / cloud platforms while ensuring high availability, security, and performance.

Responsibilities:

  1. SaaS Infrastructure Design and Implementation:
    • Design and implement SaaS/cloud-based infrastructure solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and optimal performance.
    • Develop and maintain architecture blueprints, documentation, and standard operating procedures for Linux and/or SaaS systems.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define system requirements and ensure seamless integration with other technologies.
  2. System Administration and Support:
    • Provide expert-level support for SaaS systems, including troubleshooting complex issues, performance optimization, and system tuning.
    • Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and recommend appropriate solutions.
    • Implement security best practices, including user management, access control, and system hardening.
    • Ensure timely patching and updates of SaaS systems, following established change management processes.
  3. Automation and Configuration Management:
    • Utilize various tools, such as Data Dog, Gitlab, Jira, etc., to automate deployment, configuration, and management of SaaS infrastructure.
    • Develop and maintain various playbooks, templates, and configurations for provisioning and managing resources.
    • Continuously improve automation workflows to streamline processes and increase efficiency.
  4. Linux Server Virtualization:
    • Manage VMware-based virtualized environments, including vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter Server.
    • Provision and maintain virtual machines, templates, and snapshots.
    • Monitor virtual infrastructure performance and troubleshoot issues related to virtualization.
  5. Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing:
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide guidance and expertise on Linux-related matters.
    • Share knowledge and mentor junior team members, promoting professional growth and development.
    • Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in Linux technologies, attending conferences and training sessions as needed.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in software design, information technology or related field
  • Extensive experience as cloud-platform administrator or engineer, with a focus on AWS, Azure, GCP and general infrastructure such as load balancers, proxies, DNS, networking, hybrid and storage
  • Extensive experience as a Linux Administrator or Engineer, with a focus on Ansible, Terraform, Ubuntu, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, VMware, and Packer.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-platform and/or Linux operating systems, including system administration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and security.
  • Proficiency in automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible, Terraform, and Packer.
  • Solid understanding of virtualization technologies, particularly VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter Server.
  • Experience in designing and implementing Linux-based infrastructure solutions, considering scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Knowledge of scripting languages like Java, Javascript, C, C++, PHP, Linux shell, Bash, Python, or Perl for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, RHCE, VCP, LPIC, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate are highly desirable.

title: Crib Attendant
description:
At Coulson Aviation, we’re proud to provide skilled employment opportunities in Port Alberni while supporting wildfire response operations around the world. From our headquarters on Vancouver Island, our team helps protect communities through industry-leading aerial firefighting operations across Canada, the United States, Australia, and Chile.

As Coulson Aviation continues to grow, we are looking for a dependable and organized Crib Attendant to join our team in Port Alberni, BC. This full-time, onsite position plays an important role in keeping our hangar operating efficiently by ensuring tools, equipment, and consumables are properly controlled and readily available.

WHY JOIN COULSON AVIATION?

  • $22 an hour.
  • Company-paid health and dental benefits.
  • 5% employer-matching pension plan.
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • The opportunity to gain experience within the aviation industry.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Maintain key-control records for company vehicles and ground support equipment.
  • Restock safety supplies, including earplugs, safety glasses, and other personal protective equipment.
  • Monitor inventory stored in flammable-material cabinets and identify expired or soon-to-expire products.
  • Transport time-sensitive aircraft parts as a courier during Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • A high school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in a tool crib, inventory, warehouse, stores, or similar environment is preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with inventory-control and record-keeping practices.
  • Basic computer skills and the ability to learn inventory-tracking systems.
  • Physical ability to lift and carry materials, remain standing for extended periods, and perform other physically demanding tasks.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with employees across the organization.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
  • A safety-focused and dependable approach to work.
  • Familiarity with aviation terminology, procedures, or regulatory requirements is considered an asset but is not required.

We recognize that strong candidates may bring transferable experience from warehousing, shipping and receiving, inventory control, automotive parts, construction, manufacturing, retail stockrooms, or another related environment. If you are organized, dependable, comfortable working with tools and inventory, and interested in gaining aviation experience, we encourage you to apply.

We support diversity, equity, and a workplace that is free from harassment and discrimination. We are committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities. If you require accommodation during any stage of the application process, please notify us, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

title: Service Coordinator ECI
company: Hill Country Mental Health and Developmental Disabilities Centers
description:
About Company:

At Camino Real Community Services, we know that life can sometimes feel heavier than we ever expected. We have built a team of talented, caring, experienced care providers who provide a place of comfort. We are dedicated to walking beside those who may be experiencing moment of worry, sadness, or uncertainty. We are a caring and knowledgeable team dedicated to walking beside individuals and families when they may be experiencing some of life's hardest seasons, including natural disasters or acts of violence.

If our mission speaks to you and you have an open and caring heart, the ability to truly listen and support, and you are called to help others find healing, we are growing our team! Join an organization that has been committed to serving our communities for over 55 years!

About the Role:

The Service Coordinator ECI (Early Childhood Intervention) plays a pivotal role in supporting young children with developmental delays or disabilities and their families by coordinating comprehensive early intervention services. This position ensures that families receive timely access to appropriate resources, therapies, and support systems tailored to their unique needs. The coordinator acts as a liaison between families, service providers, and community agencies to facilitate effective communication and service delivery. By managing individualized service plans and monitoring progress, the Service Coordinator helps promote optimal developmental outcomes for children. Ultimately, this role contributes to empowering families and enhancing the quality of life for children during critical early stages of development.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, education, nursing, or a related human services field.
  • Experience working with young children and families, preferably in early intervention or special education settings.
  • Knowledge of early childhood development and developmental disabilities.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple cases and coordinate services effectively.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Reside in Bee or Live Oak County
  • Certification or training specific to Early Childhood Intervention programs.
  • Experience with state and federal regulations related to early intervention services.
  • Bilingual abilities, especially in Spanish or other commonly spoken languages in the community.
  • Proficiency with case management software and electronic health records.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct initial and ongoing assessments to identify the needs of children and their families within the ECI program.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor individualized family service plans (IFSPs) in collaboration with families and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Coordinate and schedule services with therapists, educators, healthcare providers, and community resources to ensure seamless delivery of care.
  • Provide families with information, support, and advocacy to navigate available services and resources effectively.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of service coordination activities, progress notes, and compliance with state and federal regulations.
  • Facilitate communication among all stakeholders to resolve issues and promote collaborative problem-solving.
  • Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and professional development to stay current with best practices in early childhood intervention.

Skills:

The Service Coordinator utilizes strong interpersonal and communication skills daily to build trusting relationships with families and service providers, ensuring clear and compassionate dialogue. Organizational skills are essential for managing multiple cases, scheduling services, and maintaining detailed documentation to comply with regulatory requirements. Problem-solving and critical thinking skills enable the coordinator to address challenges proactively and adapt service plans to meet evolving family needs. Knowledge of early childhood development and intervention strategies guides the coordinator in making informed decisions and advocating effectively for children’s best interests. Additionally, proficiency with technology supports efficient case management and data tracking, enhancing overall service coordination and reporting.

title: Software Engineer (Java / AWS)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to design, build and maintain scalable applications and cloud-based solutions. You will work across the full technology stack, including backend and frontend development, APIs, system integrations, cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.

Working Hours: Mon- Fri
Working Location: Central

  • Experience with frontend frameworks such as Svelte, React or Vue.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, including services such as ECS, Kubernetes/EKS and Lambda.
  • Strong experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK, OpenTofu or similar tools.
  • Good understanding of REST APIs, GraphQL and microservices architecture.
  • Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Understanding of system integration and event-driven architecture.
  • Familiarity with application security, governance and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts and architectural designs into practical implementations.

Preferred Skills

  • Strong experience with Kotlin / Java for backend development.
  • Experience with Svelte or React for frontend development.
  • Experience deploying and supporting applications within AWS cloud environments.
  • Exposure to enterprise or large-scale modernization projects.
  • Experience working within environments with stringent security and regulatory requirements.

What We’re Looking For

A self-driven and pragmatic engineer who is comfortable working across different areas of the technology stack. You should be able to balance technical quality with business requirements, communicate effectively with different stakeholders and develop clean, maintainable and scalable solutions.

title: Employee Relations Investigator
description:
Company Overview

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Group/Division

The vision of KLA’s global human resources organization is to become a leader and partner to operating leadership in support of the company’s efforts to achieve its strategic growth, customer and operating objectives through strategic talent management. Our mission is to enable the business, and leverage human resources to achieve short and long-term business objectives. Our primary areas of strategic focus include talent acquisition, individual and organizational assessment and development, performance management, inclusion and engagement, and rewards. The global HR organization includes HR business partners, learning and development, talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, employee communications, and HR system operations.

Job Description/Preferred Qualifications

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conduct fair, thorough, and timely investigations into allegations of violations of KLA’s policies or local law and policies to ensure fair treatment of all employees.
  • Initiate and complete all investigation steps, including document review, interviews, investigation reports, recommend remedial actions, and reporting out on investigation findings, trends, and related metrics.
  • Manage and work with third party resources, such as digital forensics, investigation, and document review firms.
  • Manage document reviews, including the collection, review, and analysis of relevant documents.
  • Conduct employee training on KLA’s investigation process, including reporting channels and the importance of raising issues.
  • Support the Global Employee Relations Center of Excellence on other projects, initiatives, and strategic opportunities as may arise from time-to-time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4-year undergraduate degree in Employee Relations, Human Resources or related fields.
  • At least 8+ years professional experience conducting internal workplace investigations in-house or at a law firm.
  • Fluent in English and Mandarin (verbal and written).
  • Familiarity with employment laws in Taiwan and APAC.
  • Willingness to collaborate across teams, multiple regions and time zones, including international travel.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, influencing and writing skills.
  • Self-motivated and persistent; strong ability and comfort in exercising independent judgment for obtaining results while managing legal risk.

We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.

KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer

Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
About Zenith Education Studio

Zenith is an MOE-registered centre committed to delivering high-quality, holistic education to Primary, Secondary, and JC students. Our educators and teams are dedicated to empowering students to realise their full potential and become the best versions of themselves.

If you're passionate about transforming education and making a real impact, we want to hear from you.

About the Role

Most software in education was old ten years ago. Timetables held together by spreadsheets, portals nobody has touched since launch, processes that only work because somebody remembers the workaround.

Zenith is building what a modern learning centre should have had all along. The platform our students learn on. Systems our tutors and staff reach for rather than tolerate. Automation that clears away the work nobody should still be doing by hand.

We want an exceptional full stack engineer to build it with us, and we will be direct about what we are hiring for, because it is unusual.

The best engineers of the next decade will not be the ones who write the most code. Agents already write plenty. They will be the ones with the judgment to know what is worth building and the discipline to know when it is wrong.

That is the bar. We hire people who verify their own work, who know where their own judgment runs out, and who ask before assuming. Experience on top of that is welcome. It is not what we filter on.

What You’ll Do

Three questions sit behind everything we build. Is a student learning better because of this? Is a tutor's day easier because of it? Are our back-office processes better or faster because of it?

The learning platform, the CRM that the team works in, our public sites, the automation running between them, these are how we answer those questions at the moment. They are not the point in themselves.

Your job is to keep answering them. Features end to end, from the interface through to the database, in whichever system the problem happens to live. The judgment to work out which problem is worth solving next. And the ownership to see it hold up once real people depend on it.

And the craft underneath. Bugs traced to a real root cause rather than patched over. Clear answers for the colleagues who do not write code. Runbooks written so that nothing has to be worked out twice.

What We’re Looking For

  • You work across the full stack and care about both ends of it. The interface a student or tutor actually has to use, and the system underneath that has to stay correct and fast as it grows.

  • You can say why. Not just what your code does, but why you designed it that way and what you would do differently now.

  • You ask before assuming. When a request is ambiguous, you say so early rather than guessing and discovering the mismatch after it ships.

  • You get curious about the business. You want to know why a number matters and who depends on it, not just what shape the data is.

  • You build things because you want to. A side project, a tool to optimise your workflow, something you taught yourself recently for no reason other than curiosity.

  • You go looking where an agent cannot. The answer is often not in the code. It is in production, or in the head of the person who reported the problem, or in how the centre actually runs. You go and get it instead of accepting a plausible guess.

  • You build in compounding benefits. Every system you build should make the next one easier: clear structure, tests that mean something, decisions written down rather than remembered. The same goes for the tools you work with. When an agent gets something wrong, you fix the context it works from, so it cannot make that mistake twice.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Comfortable writing TypeScript or JavaScript, and able to pick up a new language or framework when the work calls for it

  • Familiar with version control (Git) and working with APIs. Experience running production on AWS is a plus.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 1-3 years of software development experience (strong fresh graduates are welcome to apply).

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.JavaScript, Python or similar).

  • Familiarity with version control (Git), APIs, and basic cloud concepts. AWS experience is a plus.

  • Continuous improvement, detail-oriented, and comfortable working collaboratively within a lean engineering team

Our Stack

React on the front end. Node, Express, Prisma and PostgreSQL on the back end. AWS for infrastructure, mainly ECS, Lambda and S3. We do not expect you to have used all of these. We do expect you to be able to learn them.

title: System Engineer
description:
Company Overview

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Group/Division

With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Optical Metrology Division products are used for optical overlay metrology. The portfolio of products includes unique solution packages which are based on hardware and software systems to enhance yield and effectiveness. As a world leader in its field of expertise, the division's products are the most advanced in performance (measurement accuracy of nanometers and below), reliability, ease of use and compatibility with other KLA's products. KLA (Israel) controls over 80% of the world market sales in its field, and its products are used by every major semiconductor manufacturer around the world. KLA Israel is located in the Migdal Haemek Industrial Park.

Write technical reports to communicate issues, analysis, technical assessments, system status, best-known-methods, and engineering recommendations
Be able to quickly get up to speed to design and execute multi-disciplinary experiments, write and peer review detailed test plans and summary reports for system testing
Coordinates and performs root cause analysis to solve problems
Interfaces closely with service, manufacturing, engineering and marketing team to define and optimize system performance and resolve performance issues.
Coordinate with outside vendors to perform and deliver sub-system products
Hands-on troubleshooting and maintaining of engineering prototype systems in division headquarters

Qualifications
Must have a degree in Engineering, Physics, Material Science or related fields
Have excellent oral and written communication, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills
Be able to clearly communicate with cross functional internal teams, division management, as well as external customers
Have knowledge with data analysis tools such as JMP, Matlab, Microsoft Excel
The candidate should be self-driven, yet a strong team player.
Advantageous:
Have a working knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing, optical-mechanical systems, wafer handling systems and servo control systems
Previous experience with yield and process control instrument systems for semiconductor industry

The Senior Software Engineer plays a central role within the Software Engineering team responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high-quality, full-stack applications across the firm's enterprise technology ecosystem. This role requires a seasoned engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can turn around solutions quickly without sacrificing quality, and actively integrates AI tooling into their development workflow. This individual serves as a mentor to junior engineers, helping to raise the technical bar across the team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full-stack enterprise web applications using C#, .NET, React, Node.js, and MS SQL Server, including the ongoing refactoring, modernization, and support of an existing portfolio of internally developed line-of-business applications primarily built on C#/ASP.NET MVC and SQL Server.
  • Collaborate with the Sr. AI Architect to plan, implement, and integrate AI capabilities, including LLM APIs and AI-assisted features, into scalable, maintainable solutions that span the firm's legal technology stack, including custom applications leveraging data from Aderant, Dayforce, Intapp, SharePoint Online, and the firm's MS Fabric Data Lakehouse.
  • Design and develop agentic AI applications that automate multi-step legal workflows, integrating large language models, tool-calling, and orchestration frameworks to deliver intelligent, process-driven solutions across the firm's practice groups.
  • Maintain a structured intake and delivery pipeline for AI-assisted application requests, applying engineering rigor, security review, data governance standards, and integration best practices to ensure each solution meets firm-wide quality and compliance requirements.
  • Build, consume, and maintain RESTful APIs and web services; design API contracts and ensure standards-compliant integrations across internal and third-party systems.
  • Leverage Claude Code within VS Code and other AI-powered development tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and drive engineering efficiency.
  • Provide escalation-level troubleshooting and support for internally developed applications, serving as a subject matter expert for complex issues across the team's application portfolio.
  • Mentor junior software engineers through code reviews, pair programming, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in QA processes, patch management, release control, and ongoing production support for application services.
  • Collaborate with IT infrastructure, data engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end solutions.

Essential Job Requirements:

title: Registered Dietician Nutritionist
description:
Job Title: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN)

Department: Clinical Services
Reports To: Chief Operation Officer
FLSA Status: Exempt
Position Type: Full‑Time

Greater Baden Medical Services (GBMS) is a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) dedicated to providing high-quality healthcare across Southern Maryland. With 9 clinical sites across Prince George's, Charles, and St. Mary's counties, we serve over 18,000 patients each year. We provide fully integrated care that includes primary care, pediatrics, women's health, Title X family planning, dental care, behavioral health, WIC, pharmacy services, and the Ryan White HIV/AIDS program. Our patient population is primarily made up of Medicaid and uninsured individuals. We are deeply proud to deliver these vital services to everyone in our community, regardless of their ability to pay, making Greater Baden an incredibly rewarding place to grow your career while making a tangible, life-changing impact every day.

Position Summary

The Nutritionist / Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) provides comprehensive nutrition assessment, counseling, and medical nutrition therapy to primary care adult and pediatric patients as well as individuals enrolled in the Ryan White HIV/AIDS Program within a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC). Working as part of an interdisciplinary, team‑based care model, the RDN supports disease prevention and management, HIV care, maternal and child health, and overall wellness for underserved populations. This role emphasizes culturally responsive, patient‑centered care and addresses nutrition‑related social determinants of health to improve access, engagement, and health outcomes.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Clinical Nutrition Services (Primary Care – Adult & Pediatric)

  • Conduct comprehensive nutrition assessments using anthropometric, biochemical, clinical, dietary, and socioeconomic data
  • Develop and implement individualized nutrition care plans based on evidence‑based guidelines
  • Provide medical nutrition therapy (MNT) for conditions including diabetes, hypertension, obesity, cardiovascular disease, pediatric growth concerns, prenatal and postpartum nutrition, and general wellness
  • Deliver individual and group nutrition education to patients and families using culturally and linguistically appropriate approaches
  • Collaborate with primary care providers, nurses, behavioral health clinicians, and care coordinators as part of the interdisciplinary care team

Ryan White HIV/AIDS Program Services

  • Provide nutrition counseling and MNT to Ryan White eligible clients to support treatment adherence, viral suppression, and overall health
  • Address HIV‑related nutrition needs, including weight changes, metabolic complications, and medication‑related side effects
  • Collaborate with Ryan White medical case managers and support service staff to address nutrition‑related barriers to care
  • Screen for food insecurity and connect Ryan White clients to internal and community resources
  • Document services in compliance with Ryan White program requirements, including accurate and timely entry into the electronic health record and applicable reporting systems

Care Coordination, Documentation, and Quality

  • Document all patient encounters accurately and timely in the electronic health record (EHR)
  • Participate in care conferences, huddles, and quality improvement initiatives
  • Support health center performance measures related to chronic disease management, preventive care, and retention in care
  • Assist with program reporting and compliance related to HRSA, Ryan White, and other applicable funding sources

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Nutrition, Dietetics, or a related field from an accredited institution
  • Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) credential required
  • Current state licensure or eligibility for licensure, as applicable
  • Experience providing nutrition services in a clinical or community health setting
  • Experience working with underserved populations preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of medical nutrition therapy, chronic disease management, pediatric and adult nutrition, and HIV‑related nutrition needs
  • Ability to provide trauma‑informed, culturally competent, and patient‑centered care
  • Excellent communication, counseling, and documentation skills
  • Proficiency with electronic health records and basic computer applications
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, team‑based FQHC environment
  • Commitment to health equity and the mission of community health centers

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within the Ryan White HIV/AIDS Program
  • Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist (CDCES) or eligibility
  • Bilingual (Spanish or other languages commonly spoken in the service area)
  • Experience addressing food insecurity and social determinants of health

Language Skills

Ability to read and interpret written or verbal documents and instructions. Ability to speak effectively to patients, employees and/or stakeholders of the organization.

Bilingual in Spanish/English a plus but not required.

Travel

Must be able to float between Greater Baden Medical Services, Inc. Capitol Heights and Brandywine locations as required.

title: Intern, AI Full Stack Developer
description:
ABOUT HUMMINGBIRD BIOSCIENCE

Hummingbird Bioscience is a biotherapeutics company working at the interface of artificial intelligence and human innovation to discover and develop transformative medicines for hard-to-treat diseases. Hummingbird Bioscience’s computational and systems biology technologies have generated a pipeline of innovative clinical-stage monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates in oncology and autoimmunity. At Hummingbird Bioscience, the commitment to rigorous science, teamwork, and intellectual integrity underpins our passion to accelerate the journey of new drugs from concept to clinic.

For more information, please visit www.hummingbirdbioscience.com, and follow Hummingbird Bioscience on LinkedIn, X (formerly Twitter), and YouTube.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Bioinformatics team at Hummingbird Bioscience guides strategic decisions in clinical development that impact real patients. We’re seeking an intern who will build and improve infrastructure to manage, store, and analyze clinical trial data, and who leans on AI coding tools to move faster without sacrificing quality.

In this role, you’ll enable reliable, timely data access for senior leadership (CEO, CSO, CTO, CMO, and VPs), directly influencing company decision-making and the lives of cancer patients.

What you’ll learn / be exposed to:
  • Full-stack engineering in a biotech setting (clinical oncology development)
  • Modern deployment/versioning strategies and observability
  • Data visualization techniques for scientific and clinical stakeholders
  • Common analysis patterns used in the biotech industry
  • Learn commonly used analysis in the biotech industry
  • Get exposed to clinical oncology drug development
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Build web apps, analytical dashboards, databases, and ETL pipelines supporting drug and clinical development (Flask + React)
  • Augment development with AI (e.g., LLM code assistants, test generators, refactorers) for scaffolding, code review, documentation, and rapid prototyping while following responsible-use guidelines
  • Improve and harden existing infrastructure for performance and reliability
  • Develop features for data summarization, analysis, and visualization that make insights obvious and actionable
  • Maintain Python ETL pipelines and SQL databases; optimize queries and schemas as data scales
  • Test & document: add unit/integration tests, type hints, clear READMEs, and change logs
  • Deploy safely: use CI/CD, environment configs, and versioning best practices
REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS
  • Being currently enrolled in a Bachelor or Master’s Program in Computer Science, Computational Biology, bioinformatics or related science program
  • Candidates must be currently based in Singapore and legally authorized to work in Singapore without the need for employment sponsorship.
  • Proven experience in python (FLASK), REACT for webapp/dashboard development
  • Experience in SQL querying and other database frameworks
  • Proven experience in app deployment
  • Experience in python for data cleaning and data wrangling
  • AWS experience is a plus
  • Interest in the clinical development of cancer treatment
  • Exposure to AI/LLM APIs (prompting, retrieval, tooling) or local model use
OUR MISSION & VALUES

Our fast-growing biotechnology company is committed to discovering and developing important new drugs for cancer and autoimmune diseases, and living by our values: Excellence, Determination, Teamwork, Intellectual Integrity and Audacity.

JOIN US AT THE FRONTIER OF DRUG DISCOVERY AND DEVELOPMENT

We are looking for passionate and motivated individuals committed to solving important, complex problems. We are committed to the personal and professional development of our team and offer robust learning and development programs. Hummingbird Bioscience understands the need for flexibility for our team and offers a generous paid time off program with flexibility to support employees through different life stages. We invest in our team’s health by offering competitive benefits including health and dental insurance, and a comprehensive and holistic employee assistance program. We foster a more collaborative, productive, and sociable culture with on-site lunches and snacks. Finally, we believe in creating social impact beyond our business through corporate social responsibility initiatives.

Are you ready to join us on our mission to discover and develop important new drugs for cancer and autoimmune disease?

.

title: Infection Prevention & Employee Health Mngr
description:
Title: Infection Prevention & Employee Health Program Manager

FLSA Category: Exempt

Reports To: Director of Quality and Clinical Management

Date Issued: June 2026

Greater Baden Medical Services (GBMS) is a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) dedicated to providing high-quality healthcare across Southern Maryland. With 9 clinical sites across Prince George's, Charles, and St. Mary's counties, we serve over 18,000 patients each year. We provide fully integrated care that includes primary care, pediatrics, women's health, Title X family planning, dental care, behavioral health, WIC, pharmacy services, and the Ryan White HIV/AIDS program. Our patient population is primarily made up of Medicaid and uninsured individuals. We are deeply proud to deliver these vital services to everyone in our community, regardless of their ability to pay, making Greater Baden an incredibly rewarding place to grow your career while making a tangible, life-changing impact every day.


Job Summary:

The Infection Prevention and Employee Health Program Manager provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for all infection prevention, control, and surveillance activities, as well as employee health and wellness initiatives across the organization. This role is responsible for developing, implementing, and evaluating evidence-based infection prevention programs; ensuring compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards; managing exposure control and immunization programs; and promoting a safe, healthy work environment. The Program Manager collaborates closely with clinical, operational, and administrative teams to reduce infection risk, support workforce health, and strengthen organizational readiness for audits, surveys, and public health requirements.

Essential Functions:

  1. Develops, implements, and maintains evidence‑based policies and procedures related to infection prevention, control, and employee health, ensuring alignment with regulatory and accreditation standards
  2. Participates in maintaining compliance with The Joint Commission (TJC) Infection Prevention and Control standards, including preparation for surveys and ongoing readiness activities
  3. Ensures organizational compliance with CDC, CMS, and other applicable federal, state, and local infection prevention requirements and guidelines
  4. Monitors staff adherence to infection prevention and control policies and procedures through audits, surveillance, and performance improvement activities, and provides feedback and corrective action as needed
  5. Participates in infection prevention activities and compliance monitoring, including surveillance, data analysis, reporting, and implementation of improvement initiatives to reduce infection risk
  6. Conducts educational and training activities for health care workers through instruction and dissemination of information on health care practices
  7. Serves as the Infection Control Officer and provides oversight of the infection control program
  8. Coordinates the annual Infection Control Risk Assessment and the development and implementation of the organization’s Infection Control Plans in collaboration with the Chief Medical Officer, Dental Director and Quality Director, ensuring that identified risks, mitigation strategies, and program priorities are accurately reflected and operationalized.
  9. Reports on infection prevention and control measures and organizational initiatives during designated committee meetings, including presenting data and analysis related to hand hygiene surveillance, surgical site infection tracking, antibiotic stewardship activities, respiratory virus surveillance, and other key performance indicators
  10. Conducts infection control audits and surveillance and works to improve areas of opportunities
  11. Participates in the development, implementation, and ongoing monitoring of the Infection Control Risk Assessment (ICRA) for all renovation and construction projects, ensuring appropriate mitigation strategies are identified, communicated, and followed to protect patients, staff, and the environment from potential infection risks.
  12. Serves as the Respiratory Program Administrator for GBMS’ Respiratory Protection Program
  13. Conducts on‑hire and annual respiratory FIT testing for all applicable employees, including scheduling, administration, documentation, and compliance tracking in accordance with OSHA Respiratory Protection Standards.
  14. Provides leadership, oversight, and operational management for the organization’s Team Member Health and Wellness Program, including program development, implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement to support a safe, healthy, and engaged workforce.
  15. Responsible for the oversight, coordination, and implementation of the organization’s annual employee influenza vaccination program, including planning, education, administration, tracking, and compliance monitoring.
  16. Provides education to staff on required and recommended immunizations, promotes vaccine uptake through ongoing communication and engagement, and monitors compliance with organizational and regulatory immunization requirements.

Supervisory Responsibility -None

Minimum Qualifications

  1. Current Registered Nursing License in the State of Maryland or compact state required; Licensed Practical Nurse will be considered with relevant experience
  2. Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing preferred
  3. Experience in infection control and employee health a plus
  4. Current Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation Certificate (CPR) required
  5. Certification in Infection Control preferred
  6. Five (5) or more years of experience in healthcare
  7. Strong written and verbal communication skills


Substitutions - None

Core Competencies Needed

Problem Solving – Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; gathers and analyzes information skillfully, develops alternative solutions; works well in group problem solving situations; uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

Communication Skills - Listen and verbally in order to solve problems and provide information and direction, ensuring the experience is a positive one. Record issues and resolutions to maintain accurate records and data for further analysis by management.

Analytical Skills - The ability to tackle a problem by using a logical, systematic, sequential approach. Possess creative thinking, learning, systems thinking and problem solving. Must be effective at defining and solving problems in order to ensure that the real, underlying challenge is understood and that solutions actually address it.

Healthcare Systems - Knowledge of healthcare and medical terminology.

Risk Management/Compliance - Confidentiality principles and laws, maintain compliance with government contractual mandates.

Work Environment

This job operates in an outpatient office environment.

Physical and Mental Demands

  1. Ability to cope with stress.
  2. The person in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the center
  3. Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine and computer printer.
  4. The person in this position frequently communicates with employees. Must be able to summarize and exchange accurate information.
  5. Performs with frequent interruption or distractions.
  6. Adjust priorities quickly as circumstances dictate.
  7. Cognitive ability to analyze, count, summarize and synthesize information from multiple sources.

Language Skills

Ability to read and interpret written or verbal documents and instructions. Ability to speak effectively to patients, employees and/or stakeholders of the organization.

Travel

Must be able to drive between Greater Baden Medical Services, Inc. locations.

title: Senior/Lead Full-Stack Developer
description:
Sid is a startup incubated within DP Architects that’s building tech at the forefront of architecture. We have already released NimbleFaçade, the easiest way to automatically calculate the efficiency of building façades, but that’s just the start. We are developing proprietary AI-driven technology to process all kinds of construction data, which we are using to power many more products at various stages of development. This is not your average architectural practice playing lip service to digital transformation. We are a revenue-generating startup, backed by a global architecture firm, building technology for how architects and engineers will get their work done in the years to come.

OUR MISSION

Sid exists to make supercharged technology accessible to architects, engineers, and built-environment professionals — empowering them to do their best work, transform their profession, and uplift the lives of everyone in the buildings they create.

JOB SUMMARY

You’d be working with users at DP Architects, partner organisations and Sid’s customers to build products on top of our underlying technology, as well as improving that technology where needed. We build and validate ideas quickly before deploying and scaling them as we roll out to more users. You’ll be helping us across the whole lifecycle so, while you will primarily be building web apps using TypeScript and Angular, you’ll also be involved in shaping the product itself.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Architect, design and build high-quality software at all parts of the lifecycle from prototypes, production through iteration
  • Build both the Angular frontends and the RESTful APIs that power them
  • Get involved in every aspect of the software development lifecycle, we’re a small team so you’ll need to manage your own time well
  • Contribute to technical architecture and systems design, helping to set high standards for yourself and the team
  • Collaborate with other engineers as well as product, design, architects and clients to scope the solution so that what you build solves real pain points
  • We use LLMs to help us write code, but you should understand and approve every line of code that you push
PREFERRED SKILLS:
  • Strong understanding of TypeScript and a frontend framework (we use modern Angular but it’s easy to pick up if you know React)
  • Good knowledge of databases (we primarily use Postgres, but an understanding of different databases is a plus!)
  • Experience with CI/CD, Git, deploying to cloud environments and scaling production systems
  • As a bonus, experience with Python (many of the behind-the-scenes processing is done via Python, though we can help you upskill if you don’t have a good grasp of Python!)
  • As a bonus, any experience with construction engineering or 3D modelling software
  • Communication is important within a small team and is a core skill for this role alongside technical knowledge
  • Despite being incubated within DP Architects we are a startup, any experience with a fast-paced environment where priorities shift often is a plus

We value people who are independent thinkers and problem solvers, so if you don’t see yourself exactly in the job spec above, you can show how you have learned and overcome problems in your career. We value diverse experiences and candidates who have the willingness to approach new challenges. Let’s chat about how you might fit into our team.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

We work together in the office five days a week because collaboration is central to how we operate. At the same time, weare committed to work-life balance and respecting boundaries. We offer flexibility to work from home when needed.

title: IT Support Technician (1st Shift)
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

IT Support Technician
** On-site at our Prince George, VA facility. **
This role is to support a new factory startup in Prince George, VA manufacturing large form-factor equipment. The product will be large (shipping container size), heavy (50+ tons), and complex. This position will be part of the core factory startup and onboarding team responsible for building the operations and manufacturing staff, fitting out the building, and creating the process flow/work instructions/etc. from the ground up. Skills to include: panel and point to point wire assembly, Medium Voltage, Low Voltage, and High Power Electronic assemblies.

How Will You Make an Impact?

Provide technical support to end-users for PC, server, hardware, and software applications.

This position supports a new factory startup and is expected to operate in a dynamic, fast-changing environment where systems, processes, and infrastructure are being established. The Support Technician II will play a hands-on role in site IT bring-up, support early production ramp activities, and work closely with IT leadership, facilities, vendors, and manufacturing teams during startup and steady-state operations.

Location: On-site at our Prince George, VA facility

Shift: Monday – Friday, 6:00 AM – 2:30 PM

What Will You Do?

Core Support Responsibilities
• Load and verify software packages
• Troubleshoot and resolve end-user issues
• Install and configure PCs and peripherals
• Resolve site-level incident management requests
• Populate Knowledge Database and Configuration Management Database where appropriate
• Emphasize management of queues and adherence to SLAs and KPIs
• Install and configure PCs (imaging)
• Troubleshoot basic issues with scanners (MES / SAP RF)
• Provide phone-based or remote support for offsite users
• Purchase software and hardware via PO process
• Administer user accounts using Active Directory
• Support mobile device enrollment, configuration, and basic troubleshooting (corporate smartphones and tablets)
• Provide maintenance and support of Audio/Visual equipment
• Perform baseline support for standard IT applications
• Monitor Service Desk queues and resolve tickets in a timely manner
• Install, identify, and repair hardware and peripheral components
• Simulate or recreate user issues to resolve operating difficulties
• Maintain inventory of computer parts and logs of repairs
• Provide training and technical assistance to users

Startup & Factory Ramp Responsibilities
• Support IT infrastructure and end-user readiness activities during factory build, commissioning, and early production ramp
• Assist with initial deployment of IT equipment, workstations, printers, scanners, and shared devices across office and manufacturing floor environments
• Operate effectively in a startup environment with evolving processes, incomplete documentation, and shifting priorities
• Work hands-on in factory, warehouse, and construction-adjacent environments as systems and work areas are brought online
• Support non-standard schedules, including extended hours or weekends, during critical startup and production milestones
• Partner closely with IT leadership, facilities, manufacturing engineering, and external vendors to resolve issues impacting startup timelines
• Identify gaps, risks, or recurring issues during ramp and proactively escalate or propose improvements

Continuous Improvement & Professional Expectations
• Participate in the exchange of ideas and information within the department
• Ask questions and encourage input from team members
• Provide regular updates to appropriate managers
• Identify creative ways to reduce cost and improve efficiency
• Drive continuous improvement through trend analysis and metrics
• Ensure procedures and work instructions are efficient and not redundant
• Demonstrate strong customer service and sense of urgency
• Maintain discretion and confidentiality of IT systems and data
• Understand and embrace business and IT strategic direction
• Follow all corporate, regional, and site security, safety, and health policies

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
• High School diploma and 2-5 years of experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience
• A+ certification desired
• Knowledge of Microsoft applications and utilities

Preferred for Startup Environments
• Experience supporting manufacturing, factory floor, or warehouse IT
• Hands-on experience with new site deployments, refreshes, or large-scale rollouts

LANGUAGE & SKILL REQUIREMENTS
• Strong customer service and communication skills (verbal and written)
• Service-oriented attitude with sense of urgency
• Ability to work independently and prioritize based on business impact
• Time management and analytical troubleshooting skills
• Ability to understand basic network and system architecture
• Willingness to provide on-call support and adapt to startup demands

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
• Prolonged use of computer equipment
• Ability to sit or stand for extended periods
• Ability to lift up to 25 lbs regularly and up to 50 lbs occasionally
• Frequent walking between office and manufacturing floor areas

WORK ENVIRONMENT
• Office and manufacturing floor environment
• Exposure to moderate noise levels
• Startup phase may include time spent in partially constructed or transitioning work areas

NOTE: This position is not eligible for immigration and/or visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship by Jabil. Applicants requiring sponsorship will not be considered.

The hourly pay range for this role is $23.89 - $43.03. Job-related, non-discriminatory factors used to determine the actual offered rate include qualifications and experience, geographic location, education, external market data, and consideration of internal equity.

As part of the total rewards package, Jabil offers benefits to enhance your health, wealth and resilient self. These include medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; 401(k) retirement plan and employee stock purchase plan; and paid time off.

Three years Mold Set-Up Tech experience or training and experience in mold setting and mold repairs.

title: Applications Development Engineer
description:
Company Overview

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Group/Division

With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Surfscan group includes a team of engineers, technology development, apps engineers and product marketing focused on technology that enables wafer, IC and equipment manufacturers to develop, qualify and monitor their process tools. Defects and process non-uniformities detected on Surfscan equipment allow for early identification of yield excursions. The flagship Surfscan products include the SPx platforms for wafer surface quality and wafer defect inspection tools and systems for inspection of polished wafers, epi wafers and engineered substrates during the wafer fabrication process.

Job Description/Preferred Qualifications

· The ideal candidate will possess strong technical skills, be current in the customer use case domain, have excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to work independently.

· The candidate will also be required to work towards characterization of the tool/algorithm performance and provides clear feedback to the Engineering teams for product improvement, especially during Alpha/Beta tests.

· Strong technical skills are required to understand the functionality and capabilities of these tools and for providing root cause analysis and potential solutions for customers.

· Such skills include (but are not limited to) techniques for data analysis/processing, statistical analysis as well as the ability to quickly pick up and understand customer requirements and processes.

· >50% Domestic travelling (within Taiwan) to support key customers and <20% international travels expected

Minimum Qualifications

· Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years

· The ideal candidate will have a working knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing.

· Candidate must have excellent oral and written communication, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills.

· Candidate must be self-driven, yet a strong team player.

· Programming and scripting skills in MATLAB or Python are a plus.

We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.

KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer

Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.
