title: Courtesy Clerk
location: Sioux Falls #5, East 10th St, Sioux Falls, SD
description:
Additional Considerations (if any):

Night & Weekend Shifts Required

-

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Courtesy Clerk

Department: General

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

Our Courtesy Clerks are an essential part of the Hy-Vee experience, helping customers from the register all the way to their car and keeping the store clean, stocked, and welcoming for everyone who walks through the door. In this role, you'll package purchases, assist customers, maintain the store, and lend a hand wherever you are needed.

If you enjoy staying active, love helping people, and take pride in a store that looks and feels great, we'd love to have you on our team.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Provide prompt, friendly customer service by greeting customers with a smile, learning their names, and going out of your way to make every visit a great one

  • Package customer purchases and assist customers in transporting them to their mode of transportation

  • Bring carts in from the parking lot and cart corrals throughout your shift

  • Clean registers, restrooms, the break room, and the backroom, and sweep and mop floors as needed

  • Clean the can redemption area and empty recycle bins where applicable

  • Stock, face, and rotate merchandise, clean shelves, understand shelf tags, and know the location of merchandise in the store and backroom

  • Pull product forward on shelves to maintain a full, organized appearance

  • Check prices on products as needed

  • Maintain front end supplies including paper and plastic bags, receipt paper, and other necessary items

  • Help train new courtesy clerks

  • Deliver product to customers and assist in all departments as requested within wage and hour guidelines

  • Shovel, salt, and sand walkways as needed

  • Work with co-workers as a team to ensure customer satisfaction and a pleasant work environment

  • Assist in other areas of the store as needed and take on special projects as assigned

  • Maintain strict adherence to personal hygiene, dress standards, and all Hy-Vee policies and store guidelines

  • Report to work when scheduled and on time

Your Skills

To be successful, you'll need to be able to:

  • Follow detailed written or verbal instructions and work through tasks with a few concrete variables

  • Perform simple addition and subtraction, copy figures, and count and record accurately

  • Understand and follow verbal or demonstrated directions and communicate supply needs orally or in writing

  • Work effectively as part of a team to keep the store clean and customers happy

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Store Operations, Perishables, and Health Wellness Home; Service Managers

Education and Experience

  • No education or experience requirements; we will provide all the training you need to succeed

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

​

Working Environment

This role keeps you active throughout the store and surrounding exterior areas. You will have regular exposure to noise, temperature extremes, dampness, dirt, and cleaning chemicals or solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

About Company:

At Camino Real Community Services, we know that life can sometimes feel heavier than we ever expected. About the Role:

The Service Coordinator ECI (Early Childhood Intervention) plays a pivotal role in supporting young children with developmental delays or disabilities and their families by coordinating comprehensive early intervention services. This position ensures that families receive timely access to appropriate resources, therapies, and support systems tailored to their unique needs. The coordinator acts as a liaison between families, service providers, and community agencies to facilitate effective communication and service delivery. By managing individualized service plans and monitoring progress, the Service Coordinator helps promote optimal developmental outcomes for children. Ultimately, this role contributes to empowering families and enhancing the quality of life for children during critical early stages of development.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, education, nursing, or a related human services field.
  • Experience working with young children and families, preferably in early intervention or special education settings.
  • Knowledge of early childhood development and developmental disabilities.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple cases and coordinate services effectively.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification or training specific to Early Childhood Intervention programs.
  • Experience with state and federal regulations related to early intervention services.
  • Bilingual abilities, especially in Spanish or other commonly spoken languages in the community.
  • Proficiency with case management software and electronic health records.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct initial and ongoing assessments to identify the needs of children and their families within the ECI program.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor individualized family service plans (IFSPs) in collaboration with families and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Coordinate and schedule services with therapists, educators, healthcare providers, and community resources to ensure seamless delivery of care.
  • Provide families with information, support, and advocacy to navigate available services and resources effectively.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of service coordination activities, progress notes, and compliance with state and federal regulations.
  • Facilitate communication among all stakeholders to resolve issues and promote collaborative problem-solving.
  • Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and professional development to stay current with best practices in early childhood intervention.

Skills:

The Service Coordinator utilizes strong interpersonal and communication skills daily to build trusting relationships with families and service providers, ensuring clear and compassionate dialogue. Organizational skills are essential for managing multiple cases, scheduling services, and maintaining detailed documentation to comply with regulatory requirements. Problem-solving and critical thinking skills enable the coordinator to address challenges proactively and adapt service plans to meet evolving family needs. Knowledge of early childhood development and intervention strategies guides the coordinator in making informed decisions and advocating effectively for children’s best interests. Additionally, proficiency with technology supports efficient case management and data tracking, enhancing overall service coordination and reporting.

title: Market Grille Clerk
description:
Additional Considerations (if any):

Night & Weekend Shifts Required

-

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Market Grille Clerk

Department: Market Grille

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

Our Market Grille Clerks are at the center of one of the most exciting parts of the Hy-Vee store, serving up fresh, made-to-order food and creating a warm, welcoming experience for every customer who walks up to the counter. In this role, you'll keep things running smoothly by staying on top of orders, handling food safely, and working as part of a team that takes pride in quality and service.

If you enjoy a fast-paced environment, like working with food, and love making customers happy, this could be a great fit for you.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Provide prompt, friendly customer service, greeting customers with a smile, learning their names, and going the extra mile to make every visit a positive one

  • Take customer orders at the Market Grille counter and answer the telephone promptly, providing helpful service including taking product orders

  • Review daily orders, anticipate product needs, and prepare and replenish product as necessary

  • Pull product from the cooler or freezer to prepare for cooking and ensure an adequate food supply is ready and on hand

  • Handle food safely and review the status and appearance of food for freshness at all times

  • Maintain a clean, sanitary work area throughout your shift

  • Check in product, put product away, and review invoices as needed

  • Run the department register, receive payment, and make change where applicable

  • Remove trash in a timely manner and wash dishes as necessary

  • Price and order product and deliver orders as needed

  • Work with co-workers as a team to ensure customer satisfaction and a pleasant work environment

  • Assist in other areas of the store as needed and take on special projects as assigned

  • Maintain strict adherence to personal hygiene, dress standards, and all Hy-Vee policies and store guidelines

  • Report to work when scheduled and on time

Your Skills

To be successful, you'll need to be able to:

  • Follow detailed written or verbal instructions and work through tasks with a few concrete variables

  • Perform simple addition and subtraction, copy figures, and count and record accurately

  • Understand and follow verbal or demonstrated directions and communicate supply needs orally or in writing

  • Work effectively as part of a team to deliver a great customer experience

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Store Operations, Perishables, and Health Wellness Home; Food Service Director; Market Grille Department Manager; Assistant Market Grille Department Manager; Service Managers

Education and Experience

  • No education requirement; we will provide all the training you need to succeed

  • Six months or less of similar or related work experience; prior food service experience is a plus

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

Working Environment

This role is performed in a store kitchen environment where things stay busy and engaging throughout your shift. You'll have exposure to noise, equipment movement, temperature extremes, and cleaning chemicals or solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

The anticipated hourly starting wage for this position is $15.00 to $18.75 depending on experience.

For information on company benefits visit Benefits | Hy-Vee.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist I

The Data Scientist I provides data science, statistical, and advanced analytical support to CDC programs. This role focuses on extracting knowledge from structured and unstructured public health data to support analysis, research, surveillance, improved understanding and communication, visualization, health services delivery, and data-driven decision-making.

The Data Scientist I develops, implements, and monitors advanced analytic, computational, and predictive modeling tools and applies machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) to public health data. The position works with data from multiple surveillance systems and programs and collaborates with Data Engineering, Product Management, User Experience, subject-matter experts, and other business units to develop innovative data science solutions.

This is a scientific position requiring strong analytical and technical skills, methodological expertise, and the ability to translate complex public health data into meaningful findings, visualizations, reports, and solutions that support CDC programs and public health decision-making. This is an onsite 5 days a week CDC position, 1600 Clifton Rd NE, Atlanta, GA 30329.

Compensation & Benefits:

Estimated Starting Salary Range for Data Scientist I: $90,000.00-95,000.00/yr.

Pay commensurate with experience.

Full-time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice.

Data Scientist I Responsibilities Include:

  • Define and develop statistical and advanced analytic methods and solutions for complex data science projects.

  • Gather, integrate, process, and analyze data from multiple public health surveillance, research, and administrative sources.

  • Conduct exploratory data analysis, anomaly detection, measurement, and structured and unstructured data analysis.

  • Apply machine learning, artificial intelligence (AI), predictive modeling, and prescriptive modeling to public health data.

  • Interpret findings and translate analytical results into actionable insights for public health programs and decision-making.

  • Develop, implement, and monitor advanced analytic and computational tools for CDC programs.

  • Provide technical consultation on health science, data science, programming, and advanced analytical methods as applied to public health.

  • Collaborate with epidemiologists, statisticians, computer scientists, economists, policy analysts, public health professionals, and other subject-matter experts on surveillance, research, and analytical studies.

  • Provide methodological support and innovative solutions for complex analytical projects.

  • Develop data visualizations and other approaches to communicate findings and support understanding of public health data.

  • Support system automation and processes that improve health services delivery and decision-making.

  • Prepare comprehensive reports describing data quality, analytical methodology, results, and relevance to the public health issue under study.

  • Present and disseminate analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Data Scientist I Experience, Education, Skills, Abilities requested:

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, computer science, health science, public health, epidemiology, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.

  • Experience conducting statistical or advanced data analysis using multiple data sources, including public health surveillance, research, or administrative data.

  • Experience with data processing, exploratory analysis, anomaly detection, structured and unstructured data, and interpretation of findings.

  • Experience with predictive or prescriptive modeling, machine learning, artificial intelligence (AI), data visualization, or related advanced analytics.

  • Knowledge of health science, data science, programming, and analytical methodologies as applied to public health.

  • Ability to assess data quality, select appropriate analytical methods, and communicate results and their public health relevance.

  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary scientific, technical, and public health professionals.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analytical concepts and findings to diverse audiences.

  • Ability to develop innovative solutions and manage complex data science projects.

  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Data Scientist I Preferred Qualifications requested:

  • Experience applying advanced analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, predictive modeling, or computational methods to public health data.

  • Experience working with large, complex, structured, and unstructured datasets or public health surveillance systems.

  • Experience developing automated analytical processes or data visualizations.

As a trusted partner for more than 60 federal clients, Cherokee Federal LLCs are focused on building a brighter future, solving complex challenges, and serving the government’s mission with compassion and heart. title: CSR
description:
What are we looking for?

Do you love people and pets? Are you the kind of person who jumps in, figures things out, and keeps the day moving with a smile? If so, we’d love to meet you!

Park Veterinary Hospital & Urgent Care is looking for a self-starter, go-getter, fun-loving Client Service Representative to join our fast-paced, compassionate team.

What are we looking for in an individual to join our team?

  • A positive, upbeat person who thrives in a busy environment
  • Someone who takes initiative and doesn’t wait to be told what needs doing
  • A team player with strong communication skills
  • Able to stay calm, organized, and kind, even on hectic urgent care days
  • Veterinary or medical front desk experience is a plus, but not required, we’re happy to train the right person!

What do we expect from our CSR's?

  • Welcome clients and patients with warmth, professionalism, and genuine empathy, first impressions matter, and you set the tone.
  • Answer phones, schedule appointments, and help manage urgent care flow. Think juggling… you’ll do it all day, every day, but you’ll never do it alone. You’ll be backed by an incredible team.
  • Communicate clearly and kindly, whether it’s a routine visit or a stressful moment. Treat every client like your most important guest, the one you really want to impress.
  • Support our veterinary team to keep each day running smoothly. Strong communication is everything here, and teamwork makes the magic happen.
  • Handle payments, records, and administrative tasks with attention to detail. Yes, there’s a money side, being comfortable with basic math is a must.

Why will you love working here?

  • You’ll be part of a supportive, team-first culture where people actually help each other (no sinking or swimming alone here).
  • Laughter is encouraged — we do serious work, but we believe joy and compassion belong in the workplace.
  • Every day, you’ll have the chance to make a real difference for pets and the people who love them.
  • We offer competitive pay and benefits, based on your experience — because your skills and dedication matter.

What are the perks you will recieve?

  • Competitive compensation + Monthly Bonus Opportunities
  • Full Health, dental, vision, and mental health support (24/7 access)
  • Generous PTO, paid parental leave, and holiday pay
  • Opportunities for internal growth and career development across our network
  • 401K with employer match
  • Incentive programs recognizing team contributions to great care
  • Personal pet care discounts + Pet Insurance Discounts

If you love people and pets, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and bring positive energy wherever you go, Park Veterinary Hospital & Urgent Care would love to meet you. We’re looking for a fun-loving, motivated Client Service Representative who takes initiative, communicates well, and can juggle the day with empathy and a smile. You’ll be the welcoming face of our clinic, supporting clients, patients, and our veterinary team while making a real difference every single day. In return, you’ll join a supportive, laughter-filled workplace that values compassion, teamwork, and growth, with competitive pay, great benefits, bonus opportunities, and perks that support both you and your pets. If you’re ready to be part of something meaningful, we encourage you to apply!

title: Food & Beverage Supervisor
company: MARRIOTT RALEIGH DURHAM RESEARCH TRIANGLE PARK
description:
Come join the team at Marriott Raleigh Durham Research Triangle Park, conveniently located on the edge of Morrisville, NC! Whether you're looking to grow your hospitality career or take the next step in a welcoming, team-focused environment, we'd love to meet you. Be part of a hotel committed to exceptional guest service and professional development. Apply today and discover where your next opportunity begins!

Driftwood Hospitality Management’s company culture empowers our associates to take initiative, be proactive, and contribute to the success of their property with well-defined strategies and objectives. Driftwood Hospitality Management is renowned for our fully integrated approach to hospitality services — all with outstanding client service. Our team is made up of the best talent in the hospitality industry, down to every employee, position, and hotel.

Job Summary

The purpose of the Food & Beverage Supervisor is to oversee, control, and administer the operations of the restaurant and bar while maintaining standards.

Essential Job Functions

This description is a summary of primary responsibilities and qualifications. The job description is not intended to include all duties or qualifications that may be required now or in the future. The hotel operates 24 hours a day and 7 days a week, so operational demands require variations in shift days, starting times, and hours worked in a week.

  • Ensures that each guest receives outstanding guest service by providing a guest friendly environment which includes greeting and acknowledging every guest, maintaining outstanding standards, solid product knowledge, and all other components of guest service.
  • Maintains a favorable working relationship with all company associates to foster and promote a positive working environment.
  • Work in a fast-paced and customer service-oriented environment, perform duties under pressure and meet deadlines in a timely manner.
  • Taste food and beverage products to ensure quality and consistency.
  • Monitor F&B POS systems and report any discrepancies or system outages.
  • Support the entire food and beverage operation including supervising other areas if necessary, handling special projects, and running promotions.
  • Effectively control the flow of customers and the interaction between the front and back of house throughout service.
  • Ensure team members consistently maintain brand standards and high levels of customer service.
  • Handle all customer inquires in an appropriate and professional manner.
  • Organize and conduct pre-shift meetings communicating pertinent information to the staff such as house count, daily specials, service training, and menu changes.
  • Ensure cleanliness and workplace safety in the department.
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follows safety rules and procedures.
  • Perform any related duties as requested by manager.

title: Administrative Specialist IV
company: Hill Country Mental Health and Developmental Disabilities Centers
description:
GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


The Receptionist/Secretary works under the supervision of and reports directly to the Clinic Director. Using initiative and judgment, performs advanced secretarial duties with latitude for decision making in conducting administrative phases of the work in the absence of the Clinic Director, within bounds set forth by the Clinic Director. Assembles and organizes information for the Clinic Director and staff. With the Director, manages an efficient office system and contributes to the clinic’s quality improvement efforts.


Duties include but are not limited to answering and routing a high volume of incoming calls. Responsible for scheduling physician schedules for Adults and Children and all follow-up appointments, completing financial assessments for all programs in the service area, supplying information to callers, relay messages, greeting people, and ordering supplies. Constantly exercises vigilance in maintaining confidential files and reports.


Must have excellent communication and customer service skills, must always maintain an elevated level of professional attitude, and must be able to work in a very fast-paced work environment. Camino Real Community services practice the principles of trauma-informed care and require that all employees be trained in this area.


MINIMUM JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Graduation from an accredited high school or GED.
  • Two (2) years full-time secretarial experience of increasing complexity.
  • Experience working in a receptionist/secretary type position within a health service-related office environment.
  • Experience with office automation, computer, and/or data processing systems.


PREFERRED JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

  • One (1) year (30 semester hours) of accredited college work in a related field may substitute for one year of the required experience.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA (Health Information Privacy and Portability Act) consideration fitting the CRCS line of services.
  • Be able to speak both English and Spanish.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Knowledge of office management principles and practices and administrative procedures and of the technical program.
  • Working knowledge of health-related accounting and collection procedures and use of automated data processing in such procedures, of human resource management and office practices, and of federal and state laws, government regulation, and agency rules governing reimbursement for agency services.
  • Extensive knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid and private insurance practices and procedures.
  • Knowledge of business terminology, spelling, punctuation, grammar, and arithmetic. Knowledge of office procedures and practices.
  • Knowledge of timekeeping skills relating to data entry and posting.
  • Able to work with the public and maintain effective working relationships.
  • Ability to train other clerical staff.
  • Willingness to accept additional assignments/duties to ensure meeting departmental and agency needs.
  • Ability to serve as a back-up to other clerical positions and other duties as assigned.
  • Skill in the use of electronic data and/or word processing equipment and software.
  • Ability to implement new systems and procedures and to evaluate their effectiveness; to supervise others; and to effectively interpret programs and plans.
